help-board-settings-date-what-it-is-desc: ʻOku tuku ʻe he ʻAho ke fili ʻe ha pule ʻo e papa ha founga ʻaho pē ʻe taha ki he taha kotoa ʻi he papa ni, kae ʻikai ko e founga kuo fokotuʻu ki he saiti kakato. ʻOku ʻi he puha tatau hoʻo fili fika uike pē ʻaʻau pea, ki he kau pule ʻo e papa, ko e fakatatau kalena ʻoku ne tuku ʻa e ngaahi ʻaho ngataʻanga ʻo e ngaahi kaati ki ha kalena CalDAV hangē ko e Nextcloud.
help-board-settings-date-how-it-works-de: Fakaʻilongaʻi ʻa e Founga ʻAho ʻo e papa, fili ha founga pea lomiʻi ʻa e Tauhi; toʻo hono fakaʻilonga ke toe muimui ki he fokotuʻu ʻo e saiti. ʻOku kei ikuna pē ʻa e founga kuo fakaʻaliʻali ʻe ha mēmipa ʻi he Ngaahi fokotuʻutuʻu ʻa e Mēmipa. ʻOku fakaʻaliʻali pe tāmateʻi leva ʻe he Fakahaaʻi ʻa e uike ʻo e taʻu ʻa e ngaahi fika uike maʻau. Ki he fakatatau kalena, tohi ʻa e tuʻasila kalena, hingoa ʻo e tokotaha ngāueʻaki mo ha lea fufū ʻapi, fakaʻilongaʻi ʻa e puha fakatatau pea Tauhi.
help-board-settings-all-boards-what-it-i: ʻOku fili ʻe he Ngaahi fokotuʻutuʻu ʻo e Ngaahi papa kotoa ʻa e meʻa ʻoku fakahaaʻi ʻe he taile ʻo e papa ni ʻi he peesi Ngaahi papa kotoa, hangē ko e lau kaati ʻo e lisi taki taha mo e ngaahi tā ʻo e kau mēmipa. ʻOku fokotuʻu foki ʻe ia ʻa e motuʻa ʻo e kaati, tuku fakaʻotomētiki ki he Tauhiʻanga ʻa e ngaahi kaati taʻe ala ki ai, pea pe ʻoku fakafoʻituitui pe fevahevaheʻaki ʻa e fālahi ʻo e lisi.
help-board-settings-all-boards-how-it-wo: Fakaʻilongaʻi pe toʻo ʻa e fakaʻilonga ʻo ha laine pea ʻoku tauhi leva ia. ʻI he motuʻa ʻo e kaati, tohi ha fika ʻaho ʻe tolu ʻoku mōlia ai ʻa e ngaahi kaati ʻi ha ngaahi sitepu. Ki he tuku fakaʻotomētiki, tohi pe ko e ʻaho ʻe fiha taʻe ha ngāue ʻe lava ke nofo ai ha kaati kimuʻa pea tuku ki he Tauhiʻanga, pe tuku ia ke maha ke tāmateʻi ia. ʻOku ʻikai ʻaupito tuku ki he Tauhiʻanga ʻa e ngaahi sīpinga.
help-board-settings-board-view-what-it-i: ʻOku fili ʻe he Vīsone ʻo e Papa pe ko e fē ngaahi vīsone, hangē ko e Ngaahi hala, Ngaahi lisi, Tēpile, Kalena, Gantt pe ko e ngaahi saati, ʻoku ʻoatu ʻi he lisi fili Vīsone ʻo e Papa ʻo e papa ni, pea ko e fē ʻoku ava ai ʻa e papa. ʻOku fokotuʻu kehe ia ki he taimi ʻoku fakapuleʻanga ai ʻa e papa mo e taimi ʻoku fakafoʻituitui ai.
help-board-settings-board-view-how-it-wo: ʻOku ʻi he puha ha laine ʻe taha ki he vīsone taki taha mo ha puha fakaʻilonga ʻe fā: ko e vīsone tuʻumaʻu mo e ngaahi vīsone ʻoku fakahaaʻi ki ha papa fakapuleʻanga, pea mo e ongo meʻa tatau ki ha papa fakafoʻituitui. Fakaʻilongaʻi ʻa e puha Fakahaaʻi ʻo ha vīsone ke ʻoatu ia ʻi he lisi fili pea mo hono puha Tuʻumaʻu ke fakaava ʻa e papa ʻi ai.
help-board-settings-swimlane-what-it-is-: ʻOku tauhi ʻe he Hala ʻa e ngaahi fokotuʻutuʻu hala ki he papa kotoa: pe ʻe lava ke toho ʻa e ngaahi hala, pe ʻe lava ke liliu honau māʻolunga, pe ʻoku vahevahe ʻe he ngaahi hala kotoa ha laine ʻulu lisi pē ʻe taha, pea ko e fē ngaahi malaʻe Scrum ʻoku fakahaaʻi ʻe ha hala. ʻOku ʻi heni foki ʻa e Ngaahi Kulupu Fakangatangata Ngāue, ko e ngaahi fakangatangata ngāue lolotonga fevahevaheʻaki ʻi ha ngaahi lisi lahi.
help-board-settings-swimlane-how-it-work: Fakaʻilongaʻi ʻa e ngaahi puha ʻoku ke fie maʻu; ʻoku ʻi he tēpile ʻi ʻolunga ʻa e puha fakaʻilonga Toho. ʻOku fakahaaʻi ʻe he laine ʻulu lisi fevahevaheʻaki ʻe taha ʻa e hala kotoa mo e ngaahi lisi kotoa ʻo e papa ʻi lalo ʻi ha laine ʻulu pē ʻe taha ʻoku nofo ʻi ʻolunga, taʻe liliu ʻa e ngaahi lisi. Lomiʻi ʻa e Ngaahi Kulupu Fakangatangata Ngāue ʻi lalo ke tānaki pe fakatonutonu ʻa e ngaahi fakangatangata fevahevaheʻaki.
help-board-settings-list-what-it-is-desc: ʻOku tauhi ʻe he Lisi ʻa e ngaahi fokotuʻutuʻu lisi ki he papa kotoa: pe ʻe lava ke toho ʻa e ngaahi lisi, pe ʻe lava ke liliu honau fālahi, pe ʻoku fālahi tatau ʻa e lisi kotoa, pea mo e malaʻe Scrum ʻoku fakahaaʻi ʻe ha lisi. ʻOku fakaʻaliʻali foki ʻe ia ʻa e ngaahi tuʻutuʻuni tafe Kanban: ngaahi tuʻutuʻuni lisi, ngaahi lisi kuo vahe ki he Lolotonga mo e Kuo ʻOsi, ha poini talaʻofa mo ha fakangatangata ngāue ki he tokotaha taki taha.
help-board-settings-list-how-it-works-de: Fakaʻilongaʻi ʻa e ngaahi meʻa ʻoku ke fie maʻu; ʻoku ʻi he tēpile ʻi ʻolunga ʻa e puha fakaʻilonga Toho. ʻO kapau ʻoku ngofua ʻa e liliu lahi, toho ʻa e kau ʻi he vahaʻa ʻo e ngaahi lisi ke liliu ha fālahi. ʻOku hā pē ha laine tuʻutuʻuni tafe ʻo kapau kuo fakaʻaliʻali ʻa e meʻa ko ia ki he saiti, pea ʻi he hili ʻene ngāue, ʻoku fokotuʻu hono ngaahi fakaikiiki mei he lisi fili ʻoʻona pē ʻo e lisi taki taha.
help-board-settings-shop-what-it-is-desc: ʻOku liliu ʻe he Falekoloa ʻa e ngaahi kaati ʻo e papa ki ha falekoloa ʻi he ʻinitaneti ʻoku fakahaaʻi ʻi he vīsone papa Falekoloa. ʻOku fili ʻe ha pule ʻo e papa pe ko e fē ngaahi malaʻe fakatāutaha ko e totongi, fika koloa mo e koloa ʻoku toe, ko e fē ngaahi lisi ʻoku fakatau atu, ko e fē ngaahi fakaʻilonga ko e ngaahi faʻahinga, ko e fē feituʻu ʻoku tohi ai ʻa e ngaahi oota pea ko e fē ngaahi founga totongi ʻoku ʻoatu.
help-board-settings-shop-how-it-works-de: Fokotuʻu ʻa e ngaahi laine pea lomiʻi ʻa e Tauhi; ʻoku tauhi fakataha ʻa e meʻa kotoa pea toe sivi ʻe he sēvea. ʻOku hoko ha kaati mo ha totongi ʻi ha lisi ʻoku fakatau atu ko ha koloa. ʻOku tohi ʻa e ngaahi oota ko ha ngaahi kaati ki he lisi Ngaahi Oota, ʻa ia kuo pau ke ʻi ha papa fakafoʻituitui, pea ʻe lava ke maʻu ʻe he tokotaha fakatau ha ʻīmeili fakapapauʻi. ʻE lava foki ke ke ngaohi ʻa e Falekoloa ko e meʻa ʻoku sio ki ai ʻa e kau ʻaʻahi ʻo e papa fakapuleʻanga.
help-board-settings-card-what-it-is-desc: ʻOku fili ʻe he Kaati ʻa e meʻa ʻoku fakahaaʻi ʻe he ngaahi kaati siʻi mo e ngaahi kaati kuo fakaava ʻo e papa ni, pea ʻi he hokohoko fē, taki taha tauʻatāina. Ngāueʻaki ia ʻo kapau ʻoku falala ha papa ki ha ngaahi malaʻe siʻi, hangē ko hono tuku ʻuluaki ʻa e fakamatala pe ko e ngaahi malaʻe fakatāutaha, pe ke fakahaaʻi ʻuluaki ʻa e ʻaho ngataʻanga ʻi he ngaahi kaati siʻi.
help-board-settings-card-how-it-works-de: ʻOku ʻi he puha ha konga ʻe ua, Fakahaaʻi ʻi he Kaati Siʻi mo e Fakahaaʻi ʻi he Kaati. Fakaʻilongaʻi pe toʻo ʻa e fakaʻilonga ʻo ha konga pe malaʻe ke fakahaaʻi pe fufū ia, pea toho ʻa e ngaahi laine ke liliu honau hokohoko. ʻOku ʻi ai hano lisi fili ʻoʻona pē ʻo ha ngaahi konga mo ha ngaahi fokotuʻutuʻu lahi ange, hangē ko e Ngaahi ngāue iiki mo e ngaahi fili toho ʻo e kaati.
help-board-settings-import-export-what-i: ʻOku tohi ʻe he ʻAve ʻa e papa ni, pe ha konga ʻo ia, ki ha faile: ngaahi founga ʻoʻona pē ʻo e WeKan, tēpile fika, PDF, HTML, faile kalena mo e ngaahi founga ʻo ha ngaahi meʻangāue kehe lahi. ʻOku tānaki ʻe he ʻOmi ki loto ha meʻa mei ha ʻave WeKan ki he papa ni. ʻOku ʻikai ko ha tatau malu ʻa e ʻave ʻo ha papa ʻo e saiti kakato.
help-board-settings-import-export-how-it: ʻI he ʻAve, fili ʻuluaki ʻa e meʻa ke kau ai, pea lomiʻi ha founga pea ʻoku hiki hifo ʻa e faile. ʻI he ʻOmi ki loto, fili ha faile ʻave WeKan ʻi he founga json pe zip pea ʻoku tānaki hono meʻa ki he papa ni. ʻOku fie maʻu ʻe he ʻOmi ki loto ha ngofua ke tohi ʻi he papa, pea ʻe lava ʻe he pule ʻo e saiti ʻo tāmateʻi ha taha ʻo kinaua.
help-board-settings-notifications-what-i: ʻOku fokotuʻu ʻe he Ngaahi fakatokanga ʻa e ngaahi fokotuʻu tuʻumaʻu ʻo e papa ni ki he ʻīmeili mo e ngaahi fakatokanga ʻi loto ʻi he polokalama, hono ngaahi fakamanatu ʻaho ngataʻanga, ʻīmeili ki he kaati pea mo e founga ʻoku ʻave ai ʻa e ngaahi fakatokanga. ʻE lava pē ke fetongi ʻe he fili mahino ʻa ha mēmipa ʻa e fokotuʻu tuʻumaʻu ʻo e papa.
help-board-settings-notifications-how-it: Ki he puha fakatokanga ʻi loto mo e ʻīmeili, fili ʻa e Tuʻumaʻu ke muimui ki he fokotuʻu ʻo e saiti, pe ʻIo pe ʻIkai ke fetongi ia ki he papa ni. ʻI lalo ʻi he Ngaahi fakamanatu ʻaho ngataʻanga, tohi ʻa e ngaahi ʻaho ke fakamanatu ai, vahevahe ʻaki ha kōma, ʻa ia ko e 0 ko e ʻaho ngataʻanga pea ko e ngaahi fika toʻo ko e ngaahi ʻaho hili ia, pea lomiʻi ʻa e Tauhi. ʻOku fokotuʻu ʻe he ngaahi konga ʻave ʻi lalo ʻa e meʻa ʻoku ʻave ʻe ha fakatokanga, fakakulupu mo e taimi.
help-board-settings-webhooks-what-it-is-: ʻOku ʻave ʻe he Ngaahi Uepihuki ʻAlu ki Tuʻa ʻa e ngaahi ngāue ʻo e papa ni ki ha sēvesi kehe, hangē ko ha meʻangāue talanoa pe hoʻo fakahokohoko pē ʻaʻau, ʻi he taimi ʻoku hoko ai. ʻOku ʻave ʻe he uepihuki taki taha ʻa e tohi ʻo e ngāue fakataha mo e ngaahi hingoa mo e fehokotakiʻanga ʻo e papa, lisi, hala, kaati mo e kakai ʻoku kau ai.
help-board-settings-webhooks-how-it-work: Tohi ha hingoa, ʻa e tuʻasila naʻe ʻoatu ʻe he sēvesi tali pea, kapau ʻoku fie maʻu, ha tokeni, fili ʻa e faʻahinga pea lomiʻi ʻa e Ngaohi. ʻOku fakahaaʻi ʻe ha uepihuki kuo tauhi ha ngaahi fili lahi ange: ko e fē ngaahi ngāue ʻoku ne ʻave, ngaahi pōpoaki hangatonu ki he kau mēmipa ʻo e kaati ki he Mattermost, pea mo e founga hono fakakulupu mo e taimi ʻo hono ngaahi pōpoaki. Fakatonutonu pea toe Tauhi ia, pe ngāueʻaki ʻa e Taʻofi ʻa e Uepihuki ni ke taʻofi ia.
help-board-settings-scrum-meetings-what-: Ko ha meʻa tokoni ʻe ua ki he ngaahi fakataha Scrum, ʻoku maʻu ʻe he mēmipa kotoa ʻo e papa. Ko e Fakataha tuʻu fakaʻaho ko ha uasi ia ʻoku ne ʻoatu ki he mēmipa taki taha ʻa e taimi tatau, pea ʻoku ngaohi ʻe he Papa Sio Ki Mui ha papa foʻou ki ha sio ki mui Kamata, Taʻofi, Hokohoko Atu.
help-board-settings-scrum-meetings-how-i: ʻOku lisi ʻe he Fakataha tuʻu fakaʻaho ʻa e kau mēmipa ʻo e papa ʻi ha hokohoko kuo fefiofiʻaki; ʻoku lau hifo ʻe he Kamata ʻa e taimi ʻo e ʻuluaki tokotaha, ʻa ia ʻoku kulokula ʻo kapau ʻoku laka, pea ʻoku tuku atu ʻe he Hoko kae ʻoua ki he fakamuimui. ʻOku ngāue pē ʻa e uasi ʻi hoʻo palausa. ʻOku ngaohi mo fakaava ʻe he Papa Sio Ki Mui ha papa fakafoʻituitui foʻou mo e ngaahi lisi Kamata fai, Taʻofi fai, Hokohoko fai mo e Ngaahi meʻa ke fai.
help-board-settings-wip-limit-groups-wha: Ko ha kulupu fakangatangata ngāue ko ha fakangatangata ngāue lolotonga pē ʻe taha ʻoku vahevahe ʻe ha ngaahi lisi ʻe ua pe lahi ange fakataha, ʻi ʻolunga ʻi he fakangatangata ʻoʻona pē ʻo e lisi taki taha. ʻOku ʻaonga ia ʻo kapau ʻoku aʻu ʻa e ngāue lolotonga ki ha ngaahi lisi lahi, hangē ko e Lolotonga, Vakai mo e Sivi, pe ʻo kapau ʻoku ke fie fakangatangata ha hala kakato.
help-board-settings-wip-limit-groups-how: ʻI lalo ʻi he Tānaki kulupu fakangatangata ngāue, fakaʻilongaʻi ʻa e ngaahi lisi ke lau fakataha, pe fili ha hala pea lomiʻi ʻa e Fakahoko ki he hala ke fakaʻilongaʻi hono ngaahi lisi. Fokotuʻu ʻa e fakangatangata pea lomiʻi ʻa e Tānaki kulupu fakangatangata ngāue. ʻE lava ke liliu ha kulupu ʻoku ʻi ai ʻaki ʻa e Fakahoko, fakaʻaliʻali pe tāmateʻi ʻaki ʻa e Fakaʻaliʻali ʻa e Fakangatangata Ngāue, pe toʻo ʻaki ʻa e Tāmateʻi.
help-board-settings-subtasks-what-it-is-: ʻOku vahevahe ʻe he Ngaahi ngāue iiki ha kaati lahi ki ha ngaahi kaati iiki ange ʻe lava ke tuku, palani mo hiki taki taha, kae lisi kinautolu ʻe he kaati faʻē pea lau pe ko e fiha kuo ʻosi. ʻOku fili ʻe he ngaahi fokotuʻutuʻu ni ʻa e feituʻu ʻoku ngaohi ai ʻa e ngaahi ngāue iiki foʻou mo e founga ʻoku fakahaaʻi ai ʻe ha ngāue siʻi ʻa e kaati faʻē.
help-board-settings-subtasks-how-it-work: Fili ʻa e founga ʻoku fakahingoa ai ʻe he kaati siʻi ʻo ha ngāue siʻi ʻa e kaati faʻē, pe ʻoku ʻi ai ʻa e konga Ngaahi ngāue iiki ʻi he ngaahi kaati ʻo e papa, pea mo e papa, lisi mo e hala ʻoku ngaohi ai ʻa e ngaahi ngāue iiki foʻou. ʻI he tuʻumaʻu ʻoku nau ʻalu ki ha papa ʻoʻonautolu pē. ʻOku tānaki ʻa e ngaahi ngāue iiki tonu mei he konga Ngaahi ngāue iiki ʻo ha kaati kuo fakaava.
help-rules-what-it-is-description: ʻOku fakaʻotomētiki ʻe he Ngaahi tuʻutuʻuni ʻa e papa: ʻo ka hoko ha meʻa, ko e meʻa fakatupu, ʻoku fai ʻe he WeKan ha meʻa, ko e ngāue. Hangē ko eni, ʻo ka hiki ha kaati ki he Kuo ʻOsi, fakaʻilongaʻi ia ʻoku kakato. ʻOku ngaohi ʻa e ngaahi tuʻutuʻuni ʻe he kau pule ʻo e papa, pea ʻe lava ʻe ha papa ʻo tuku ke lau ia ʻe hono kau mēmipa.
help-rules-how-it-works-description: Tohi ha kaveinga, fili ha meʻa fakatupu pea fakafonu hono ngaahi malaʻe, pea fili ha ngāue; ʻoku tauhi ʻa e tuʻutuʻuni pea ngāue mei ai ki muʻa kae ʻoua kuo tāmateʻi. ʻI he vīsone Founga Ngāue ʻe lava ke ke langa ha ngaahi tuʻutuʻuni ʻaki hono toho ha meʻa fakatupu mo ha ngāue. ʻE lava ke liliu hingoa, tāmateʻi, ʻave mo ʻomi ki loto ʻa e ngaahi tuʻutuʻuni, pea ʻe lava ke maʻu ʻe ha tuʻutuʻuni ha ngaahi meʻa fakatupu mo e ngāue lahi ange ʻi hono ngaahi fakaikiiki.
help-member-settings-what-it-is-descript: Ko e Ngaahi fokotuʻutuʻu ʻa e Mēmipa ko hoʻo lisi fili pē ia ʻaʻau, ʻoku fakaava mei ho hingoa ngāueʻaki pe ho tā ʻi ʻolunga toʻomataʻu. ʻOku ʻi ai hoʻo ngaahi peesi pē ʻaʻau hangē ko e ʻEku ngaahi kaati, Ngaahi Kaati Ngata mo e Kuo Fakaʻilongaʻi, ngaahi sio fakalūkufua ki he papa, pea mo hoʻo ngaahi fokotuʻutuʻu fakafoʻituitui kotoa, mei he palōfila mo e lea fufū ki he lea mo e ngaahi mataʻitohi.
help-member-settings-how-it-works-descri: Lomiʻi ho hingoa ngāueʻaki pe ho tā pea fili ha meʻa; ʻoku ava hono peesi pe puha. ʻOku fakatuʻunga ʻa e meʻa ʻoku ke sio ki ai ʻi he faʻahinga ʻo hoʻo ʻakauni, ho fatongia mo e ngaahi fokotuʻutuʻu ʻo e saiti. ʻO ka fufū ʻe he palōfila meʻa ʻa ha pule ʻo e saiti ha ngaahi meʻa maʻau, ʻoku tala ʻe he lisi fili pe ko e fiha kuo fufū.
help-member-edit-profile-what-it-is-desc: ʻOku liliu ʻe he Fakatonutonu Palōfila ʻa e founga ʻoku sio ai ʻa e kakai kehe kiate koe ʻi he WeKan: ho hingoa kakato mo e ngaahi mataʻitohi ʻuluaki, pea, ʻo kapau ʻoku tuku ʻe he saiti, ho hingoa ngāueʻaki mo e tuʻasila ʻīmeili. ʻO kapau ʻoku tuku ʻe he saiti, ʻe lava foki ke ke tāmateʻi pe fufū hingoa hoʻo ʻakauni pē ʻaʻau ʻi heni.
help-member-edit-profile-how-it-works-de: Liliu ʻa e ngaahi malaʻe pea lomiʻi ʻa e Tauhi; ʻoku tāpuni ʻa e puha ʻo ka lavameʻa pea fakahaaʻi ʻa e fehalaaki ʻo ka ʻikai. ʻOku taʻe tali ha hingoa ngāueʻaki pe tuʻasila ʻīmeili kuo ngāueʻaki ʻe ha ʻakauni kehe, pea ʻoku fakaʻilongaʻi ha tuʻasila ʻīmeili kuo liliu ko e teʻeki fakapapauʻi. ʻOku toʻo ʻe he Tāmateʻi hoʻo ʻakauni taʻe lava ke toe fakafoki, kae tauhi ʻe he Fufū hingoa ʻo e ʻakauni ho hisitōlia kae fetongi ho hingoa.
help-member-change-settings-what-it-is-d: ʻOku tauhi ʻe he Liliu Ngaahi fokotuʻutuʻu hoʻo ngaahi fili fakafoʻituitui ki he fakatonutonu mo e fakahaaʻi, hangē ko e ngaahi kau toho, fakaʻilongaʻi ʻa e ngaahi kaati kuo liliu talu mei hoʻo fakaava fakamuimui, ʻa e tapa tokangaʻi, tauhi ʻa e ngaahi fakatonutonu ʻaki ʻa e Enter, fakaava ha ngaahi kaati lahi ʻi he taimi tatau mo e longoaa ʻo e lisi sivi. ʻOku nau ngāue maʻau pē, ʻi he papa kotoa.
help-member-change-settings-how-it-works: Lomiʻi ha meʻa liliu ke fakaʻaliʻali pe tāmateʻi ia; ʻoku fakahaaʻi ʻe ha fakaʻilonga tonu ʻoku ngāue ia pea ʻoku tauhi leva ia. Ki he Fakahaaʻi ʻa e lau kaati ʻo kapau ʻoku laka ʻa e lisi ʻi he, tohi ha fika pea lomiʻi ʻa e Tauhi. ʻOku ʻi ai ʻa e ngaahi meʻa ʻoʻona pē ʻo e founga ʻaho, kamataʻanga ʻo e uike mo e ngaahi fakatokanga ʻi he Ngaahi fokotuʻutuʻu ʻa e Mēmipa.
help-member-change-color-what-it-is-desc: ʻOku fokotuʻu ʻe he Liliu lanu hoʻo kaveinga lanu pē ʻaʻau ki he WeKan. ʻOku ne fetongi ʻa e kaveinga ʻo e saiti ʻi he feituʻu kotoa pea mo e lanu ʻoʻona pē ʻo e papa ʻi he ngaahi peesi papa, ka maʻau pē.
help-member-change-color-how-it-works-de: Lomiʻi ha sīpinga kaveinga; ʻoku fakahoko leva ia. Ki he ngaahi kaveinga lafalafa mo maʻa ʻe lava ke ke fili hoʻo ngaahi lanu pē ʻaki ʻa e ngaahi fuopotopoto lanu pea sio kiate kinautolu ʻi he sio ki muʻa. Fili ʻa e Kaveinga tuʻumaʻu ke toʻo hoʻo fili pea toe sio ki he ngaahi lanu ʻo e papa pe ʻo e saiti.
help-member-change-font-what-it-is-descr: ʻOku tuku ʻe he Mataʻitohi ke ke fili ʻa e faʻahinga mataʻitohi, lahi ʻo e tohi mo e lanu ʻo e tohi ʻo e fakafeʻiloaki WeKan kakato maʻau. ʻOku tokoni ia ki he lau, hangē ko ha lahi ange pe ha lanu ʻoku feʻunga mo ho mata.
help-member-change-font-how-it-works-des: Lomiʻi ʻa e Tuʻumaʻu pe ha taha ʻo e ngaahi meʻa lomiʻi mataʻitohi; ʻoku ʻoatu pē ʻa e ngaahi mataʻitohi kuo fokotuʻu ʻi hoʻo palausa. Fili ha lahi pea fili ha lanu tohi ʻi he fuopotopoto lanu, pe lomiʻi ʻa e Toʻo ke foki ki he lanu ʻo e kaveinga. ʻOku ngāue leva ʻa e ngaahi liliu pea tauhi ki ho palōfila, pea ʻoku fakahaaʻi ʻe he laine sio ki muʻa ʻa e ola.
help-member-change-avatar-what-it-is-des: Ko ho tā ko e kiʻi tā ia ʻoku fakahaaʻi maʻau ʻi he ngaahi kaati, ʻi he ngaahi lisi mēmipa, ngaahi fakamatala mo e ʻulu. ʻOku tuku ʻe he Liliu Tā ke ke hiki hake ha ngaahi tā, fili pe ko e fē ʻoku ngāueʻaki, tāmateʻi kinautolu, pe foki ki ho ngaahi mataʻitohi ʻuluaki.
help-member-change-avatar-how-it-works-d: Lomiʻi ʻa e Hiki hake ha tā pea fili ha ʻīmisi; ʻoku tānaki ia ki he lisi, pea ko hono lomiʻi hono laine ʻoku ne ngaohi ia ko ho tā, kuo fakaʻilongaʻi ʻaki ha fakaʻilonga tonu. Lomiʻi ʻa e Ngaahi mataʻitohi ʻuluaki ke fakahaaʻi ho ngaahi mataʻitohi ʻuluaki ʻi hono fetongi. ʻOku tāmateʻi ʻe he fakaʻilonga kapaʻi veve ha tā hili hoʻo fakapapauʻi. ʻOku fakahaaʻi ʻe he puha ʻa e ngaahi fakangatangata ʻo e lahi mo e faʻahinga faile ʻo kapau ʻoku fokotuʻu ia ʻe he saiti.
help-member-change-password-what-it-is-d: ʻOku fetongi ʻe he Liliu Lea fufū ʻa e lea fufū ʻoku ke hū ai ki he WeKan. ʻOku maʻa e ngaahi ʻakauni ʻoku ʻi ai ha lea fufū WeKan; ko e ngaahi ʻakauni ʻoku hū ʻi ha sēvesi kehe ʻoku nau liliu ʻenau lea fufū ʻi ai.
help-member-change-password-how-it-works: Tohi hoʻo lea fufū lolotonga, pea ko e lea fufū foʻou tuʻo ua, pea ʻave. Mahalo ʻe fie maʻu ʻe he saiti ha lōloa siʻisiʻi taha pea taʻe tali ʻa e ngaahi lea fufū ʻoku ofi fau ki ho hingoa ngāueʻaki pe ʻīmeili, pe kuo maʻu ʻi ha ngaahi kaihaʻa fakamatala ʻiloa. Hili ʻa e liliu ʻoku hū ki tuʻa ʻa e fakataha kotoa ʻo hoʻo ʻakauni, pea ʻoku ke toe hū ki loto ʻaki ʻa e lea fufū foʻou.
help-member-passkeys-what-it-is-descript: ʻOku tuku ʻe ha kī hū ke ke hū ki loto ʻaki ʻa e fakaʻilonga tuhu, mata, loka ʻo e sikilini pe kī malu ʻo e meʻangāue ni kae ʻikai ko hoʻo lea fufū. ʻOku nofo ʻa e kī hū ʻi hoʻo meʻangāue pea ʻoku tauhi pē ʻe he WeKan hono konga fakapuleʻanga.
help-member-passkeys-how-it-works-descri: Tohi ha hingoa hangē ko e ʻEku telefoni pea lomiʻi ʻa e Tānaki ha kī hū ʻi he meʻangāue ni, pea fakapapauʻi ʻaki hoʻo loka sikilini ʻo ka kole ʻe he palausa. ʻOku lisi hoʻo ngaahi kī hū mo honau ngaahi hingoa mo e ʻaho, pea ʻoku toʻo ʻe he fakaʻilonga kapaʻi veve ha taha. ʻO kapau ʻoku ʻikai lava ʻe he palausa ʻo ngaohi ha ngaahi kī hū, ʻoku tala ia ʻe he puha.
help-member-sqrl-what-it-is-description: ʻOku tuku ʻe he SQRL ke ke hū ki loto ʻaki hono sikeni ha koti QR ʻaki ha polokalama SQRL, taʻe ha lea fufū. ʻI heni ʻoku ke tānaki tuʻo taha pē hoʻo ʻilo SQRL ki hoʻo ʻakauni, pe toe toʻo ia.
help-member-sqrl-how-it-works-descriptio: Lomiʻi ʻa e Tānaki ʻeku ʻilo SQRL pea ʻoku hā mai ha koti QR. Sikeni ia ʻaki ha polokalama SQRL, pe lomiʻi ʻa e Fakaava ʻa e polokalama SQRL ki ha polokalama ʻi he komipiuta ni; ʻoku tala atu ʻe he puha ʻa e taimi naʻe tānaki ai ʻa e ʻilo, pe ʻo kapau kuo ngata pe kuo hala ʻa e koti. ʻOku toʻo ʻe he Toʻo ʻeku ʻilo SQRL ia mei hoʻo ʻakauni.
help-member-two-factor-what-it-is-descri: ʻOku ngaohi ʻe he fakapapauʻi founga ua ke kole ʻe he hū ki loto ha koti fika ʻe 6 mei ha polokalama fakapapauʻi ʻi ho telefoni hili hoʻo lea fufū, ko ia ʻoku ʻikai feʻunga pē ha lea fufū kuo kaihaʻasi ke hū ki hoʻo ʻakauni.
help-member-two-factor-how-it-works-desc: Lomiʻi ʻa e Fakaʻaliʻali ʻa e Fakapapauʻi Founga Ua, pea sikeni ʻa e koti QR ʻaki ha polokalama fakapapauʻi pe tohi ʻa e koti ʻoku fakahaaʻi ʻi lalo ai ki he polokalama. Tohi ʻa e koti fika ʻe 6 ʻoku fakahaaʻi ʻe he polokalama pea lomiʻi ʻa e Fakapapauʻi mo Fakaʻaliʻali. Mei ai ki muʻa ʻoku kole ʻe he hū ki loto ha koti, pea ʻe lava ʻe he puha tatau ʻo toe tāmateʻi ia kae ʻoua kuo fie maʻu ia ʻe hoʻo pule.
help-member-hidden-boards-what-it-is-des: ʻOku lisi ʻe he Ngaahi papa fufū ʻa e ngaahi papa naʻa ke mavahe mei ai ka ʻe kei lava ke ke aʻu ki ai ʻi ha timi, ha kautaha pe ho tuʻasila ʻīmeili, ko ia naʻe fufū kinautolu ʻe he WeKan maʻau ʻi hono fetongi. Ko hono mavahe mei ha papa pehē ʻoku ʻikai liliu ai hoʻo kau mēmipa ʻi ha timi pe kautaha.
help-member-hidden-boards-how-it-works-d: ʻOku fakahaaʻi ʻe he puha ha laine ʻe taha ki he papa fufū taki taha, pe ʻoku tala ʻoku ʻikai ha taha. Lomiʻi ʻa e Fakafoki ʻi he tafaʻaki ʻo ha papa ke toe ʻomi ia ki he Ngaahi papa kotoa. ʻOku toʻo pē ʻe ia mei hoʻo lisi fufū pē ʻaʻau; ʻoku kei fili pē ʻe he papa tonu pe ʻe lava ke ke fakaava ia.
help-member-change-language-what-it-is-d: ʻOku fili ʻe he Liliu Lea ʻa e lea ʻo e fakafeʻiloaki WeKan maʻau. ʻOku tauhi hoʻo fili ki ho palōfila, ko ia ʻoku muimui ia kiate koe ki he palausa kotoa pē. Kae ʻoua ke ke fili, ʻoku muimui ʻa e WeKan ki he ngaahi lea ʻo hoʻo palausa pea foki ki he lea Pilitānia.
help-member-change-language-how-it-works: ʻOku lisi ʻa e ngaahi lea ʻaki honau hingoa pē ʻoʻonautolu, mo ha fuka, ha laine feituʻu ki he ngaahi lea fakafeituʻu pea mo ha fakamatala ki he ngaahi lea ʻoku tohi mei he toʻomataʻu ki he toʻohema; ʻoku ʻi ai ha fakaʻilonga tonu ʻi he lea lolotonga. Lomiʻi ha lea pea ʻoku liliu leva ʻa e fakafeʻiloaki.
help-member-invite-people-what-it-is-des: ʻOku ʻave ʻe he Fakaafe Kakai ha ʻīmeili mo ha koti fakaafe ki he kakai ʻoku teʻeki ai ke nau maʻu ha ʻakauni, ko ia ʻe lava ke nau lesisita lolotonga kuo tāmateʻi ʻa e lesisita fakafoʻituitui. ʻOku tuku ʻe ia ke ʻomi ʻe he kau mēmipa ʻo e tuʻasila ʻīmeili ʻoʻona pē ʻo e kautaha honau kaungāngāue taʻe ha pule.
help-member-invite-people-how-it-works-d: Tohi ʻa e ngaahi tuʻasila ʻīmeili, ʻe taha ʻi he laine pe vahevahe ʻaki ha kōma, fakaʻilongaʻi ʻa e ngaahi papa ʻoku totonu ke nau kau ki ai ʻi he taimi ʻoku nau lesisita ai, pea lomiʻi ʻa e Fakaafe. ʻOku tala ʻe he puha pe naʻe ʻave ʻa e ngaahi fakaafe. ʻOku fie maʻu ha fatongia papa ʻoku ngofua ke fakaafe ki he papa kotoa kuo fakaʻilongaʻi, pea ʻoku taʻofi ʻe ha tuʻasila kuo ʻi ai ha ʻakauni ʻa e ʻave.
help-member-date-what-it-is-description: ʻOku fili ʻe he ʻAho ʻa e founga ʻoku tohi ai ʻa e ngaahi ʻaho maʻau, hangē ko e taʻu-māhina-ʻaho pe ʻaho-māhina-taʻu, mo e taimi pe taʻe ʻi ai. ʻOku ikuna ʻa hoʻo founga kuo fakaʻaliʻali ʻi he ʻa e papa mo e saiti. ʻOku fokotuʻu ʻe he puha tatau ʻa e ʻuluaki ʻaho ʻo e uike mo e founga kalena.
help-member-date-how-it-works-descriptio: ʻOku fakahaaʻi ʻe he ʻolunga ʻo e puha ʻa e ngaahi founga ʻo e saiti mo e papa lolotonga, ko ia ʻe lava ke ke sio ki he meʻa te ke tukufakaholo. Fakaʻilongaʻi ʻa e Ngaahi fokotuʻutuʻu ʻa e Mēmipa: Founga ʻAho pea fili ha founga, fokotuʻu ʻa e kamataʻanga ʻo e uike mo e founga kalena ʻo kapau ʻoku ke loto ki ai, pea lomiʻi ʻa e Tauhi. Toʻo hoʻo founga pea tauhi ke toe muimui ki he papa pe saiti.
help-bookmarks-what-it-is-description: Ko e kulupu fetuʻu ʻi he ʻulu ko hoʻo lisi fili ia ʻo e ngaahi fakaʻilonga peesi: ʻoku ne tauhi ʻa e ngaahi papa, ngaahi peesi WeKan kehe, pea mei honau ngaahi lisi fili pē ʻa e ngaahi hala, lisi mo e kaati ʻoku mamaʻo pē ʻaki ha lomiʻi ʻe taha. Ko hoʻo ngaahi fetuʻu ʻoku ʻaʻau pē.
help-bookmarks-how-it-works-description: Lomiʻi ʻa e fetuʻu ke fakaʻilongaʻi pe toʻo ʻa e fetuʻu ʻo e papa pe peesi ʻoku ke ʻi ai; ʻoku fakahaaʻi ʻe he lau pe ko e fiha ʻoku ke maʻu. Lomiʻi ʻa e fakaʻilonga tuʻu pe ko e lau ke fakaava ʻa e lisi pea lomiʻi ha laine ke ʻalu ki ai, pe Sio ki he ngaahi meʻa kotoa kuo fakaʻilongaʻi ki he peesi Kuo Fakaʻilongaʻi kakato. ʻI he Ngaahi papa kotoa ʻi he Kuo Fakaʻilongaʻi ʻe lava ke ke toʻo ʻa e fetuʻu ʻo e ngaahi taile pea toho kinautolu ke fakahokohoko.
help-card-similar-cards-what-it-is-descr: ʻOku lisi ʻe he Ngaahi kaati tatau ʻa e ngaahi kaati ʻo e papa ni ʻoku hangē taha honau kaveinga mo e fakamatala ki he kaati ni, ko ia ʻoku ʻilo ha tatau hono ua ʻo e ngāue tatau kimuʻa pea fai tuʻo ua ʻa e ngāue. ʻOku fakaʻilongaʻi ha hoa ofi ʻaupito ko e Mahalo ko ha tatau.
help-card-similar-cards-how-it-works-des: ʻOku fakahaaʻi ʻi heni ʻa e kaati tatau ʻe nima ki lalo, taki taha mo e lisi ʻoku ʻi ai, pea ʻoku lau kinautolu ʻe he ʻulu. Lomiʻi ha taha ke fakaava ia. Ko e fakatatau ko ha fakahoa tohi angamaheni pē ʻoku fai ʻe he sēvea, taʻe ha sēvesi poto fakaʻotomētiki. ʻE lava ke fufū ʻa e konga ʻi he Ngaahi fokotuʻutuʻu ʻo e Papa ʻi he Kaati, laine Ngaahi kaati tatau, Fakahaaʻi ʻi he Kaati.
help-card-activities-what-it-is-descript: Ko e Ngaahi Ngāue ko e lisi hisitōlia ʻoʻona pē ia ʻo e kaati: ko hai naʻa ne ngaohi ia, liliu hono kaveinga, tānaki ha fakaʻilonga, hiki ia, tohi ha fakamatala pe pipiki ha faile, pea ʻi he taimi fē. ʻOku ne tali ʻa e meʻa kuo hoko ki he kaati ni taʻe ʻeke ki ha taha.
help-card-activities-how-it-works-descri: ʻOku lisi fakahokohoko ʻa e ngaahi meʻa foʻou taha, mo e ngaahi kaveinga, fakaʻilonga, konga fakamatala mo e hingoa faile ʻoku fakahaaʻi ʻi he founga tatau mo ia ʻi he kaati tonu. Lomiʻi ha kaveinga fehokotaki ke ʻalu ki he kaati, lisi pe papa ko ia. ʻE lava ʻe ha pule ʻo e saiti ʻo fili ʻi he Palanisi ʻo e pule ʻi he Ngaahi fokotuʻutuʻu ʻi he Malu ke fakahaaʻi ʻa e tohi faʻu ko e tohi angamaheni pe taʻe ha ngaahi fehokotakiʻanga ʻe lava ke lomiʻi.
help-card-labels-what-it-is-description: Ko e Ngaahi fakaʻilonga ko e ngaahi fakaʻilonga lanu ia ʻo e papa, ʻoku ngāueʻaki ke fakakulupu mo fakamaʻa ʻa e ngaahi kaati ʻaki ʻa e kaveinga, mahuʻinga pe ha meʻa pē ʻoku loto ki ai ʻa e timi. ʻE lava foki ke maʻu ʻe ha fakaʻilonga hano ʻaho ngataʻanga ʻoʻona pē, ʻa ia ʻoku ne ngaohi ia ko ha maka maile maʻamaʻa hangē ko e Sipulingi 1 pe v2.0 ki he kaati kotoa ʻoku ʻi ai.
help-card-labels-how-it-works-descriptio: Lomiʻi ha fakaʻilonga pe ko e meʻa lomiʻi tānaki ke fakaava ʻa e puha fakaʻilonga, pea lomiʻi ʻa e ngaahi fakaʻilonga ke tuku ki he kaati pe toʻo; ʻoku fakahaaʻi ʻe ha fakaʻilonga tonu ʻa e ngaahi meʻa kuo fili. ʻOku fakatonutonu ʻe he peni ʻi he tafaʻaki ʻo ha fakaʻilonga hono hingoa, lanu mo e ʻaho ngataʻanga, pea ʻoku fakahaaʻi ʻe ha fakaʻilonga mo ha ʻaho ngataʻanga ʻa e ʻaho ko ia ʻi hono tafaʻaki. ʻOku ʻi he konga tatau ni ʻa e ngaahi sitika mo e ngaahi feituʻu.
help-card-dates-what-it-is-description: ʻOku ʻi ai ha ʻaho ʻe fā ʻo ha kaati ʻoku ʻikai fie maʻu: Maʻu ki he taimi naʻe aʻu mai ai ʻa e ngāue, Kamata ki he taimi naʻe kamata ai ʻa e ngāue, Ngata ki he ʻaho ngataʻanga pea Fakaʻosi ki he taimi naʻe ʻosi ai. ʻOku lanu ʻa e fakaʻilonga ʻaho ngataʻanga ʻo fakatatau ki he fakavavevave pea lau ʻa e ngaahi ʻaho ʻoku toe, ko ia ʻoku hā mahino ʻa e ngāue tōmui ʻi he papa.
help-card-dates-how-it-works-description: Lomiʻi ʻa e fakaʻilonga tānaki ʻi he tafaʻaki ʻo ha ʻaho, pe ko e fakaʻilonga ʻo e ʻaho, fili ʻa e ʻaho mo e taimi pea tauhi; ko ha ʻaho ngataʻanga taʻe ha taimi kuo fili ʻoku maʻu ʻa e 17:00. Toe fakaava ʻa e puha tatau ke liliu pe tāmateʻi ia. ʻO kapau ʻoku ngāue ʻa e ngaahi kī nounou, ko hono lomiʻi ʻa e d ʻi ha kaati ʻoku ne fakaava hono ʻaho ngataʻanga. ʻOku lau foki ʻe he kaati pe ko e tuʻo fiha kuo liliu hono ʻaho ngataʻanga.
help-card-members-what-it-is-description: ʻOku tala ʻe he konga Kau mēmipa pe ko hai ʻoku kau ki he kaati: hono kau mēmipa, kau kuo tuku ki ai, ko hai naʻa ne ngaohi ia, ko hai naʻa ne kole ʻa e ngāue mo hai naʻa ne tuku ia. ʻE lava ke tauhi ʻe he Kole ʻe mo e Tuku ʻe ha kau mēmipa ʻo e papa pea mo ha fakamatala tohi tauʻatāina, hangē ko ha hingoa mei ha meʻangāue muimui kehe.
help-card-members-how-it-works-descripti: Lomiʻi ʻa e fakaʻilonga tānaki fuopotopoto ʻi ha laine ke fakaava ha lisi ʻo e kau mēmipa ʻo e papa pea fili ha kakai; ʻoku fakahaaʻi kinautolu ko ha ngaahi tā pe ngaahi mataʻitohi ʻuluaki, pea ko hono toe lomiʻi ha tā ʻoku ne toʻo kinautolu. ʻI lalo ʻi he Kole ʻe mo e Tuku ʻe, ʻoku tohi ʻe he fehokotakiʻanga Tānaki ʻi lalo ʻi he fakaʻilonga tānaki ʻa e tohi tauʻatāina ʻi hono fetongi. ʻOku fili ʻi he Ngaahi fokotuʻutuʻu ʻo e Papa ʻi he Kaati pe ko e fē ngaahi laine ʻoku hā.
help-card-fields-what-it-is-description: ʻOku tauhi ʻe he konga Kaati ʻa e ngaahi malaʻe ngāue ʻoʻona pē ʻo e kaati, hangē ko hono ngaahi fehokotakiʻanga, tuʻunga taʻofi, kalasi ʻo e sēvesi, ngaahi maaka mahuʻinga, fika fakahokohoko mo hono ngaahi meʻa lomiʻi kaati. ʻOku fakahaaʻi ʻe ha kaati kuo fakaava ʻa e malaʻe kotoa kuo fili ʻe he papa ke fakahaaʻi ʻi he ngaahi kaati, maha pe ʻikai, kuo mateuteu ke fakafonu.
help-card-fields-how-it-works-descriptio: Fakafonu pe liliu hangatonu ha malaʻe ʻi he konga ni. ʻOku fili ki he papa kakato ʻi he Ngaahi fokotuʻutuʻu ʻo e Papa ʻi he Kaati, ʻi he konga Fakahaaʻi ʻi he Kaati, ʻa e meʻa ʻoku hā ʻi heni, ʻi he konga fē pea ʻi he hokohoko fē: fakaʻilongaʻi pe toʻo ʻa e fakaʻilonga ʻo ha laine, pe toho ia ke fakahokohoko. ʻOku muimui ʻa e kaati siʻi ki he konga Fakahaaʻi ʻi he Kaati Siʻi ʻi he founga tatau.
help-card-time-what-it-is-description: ʻOku tohi ʻe he lekooti taimi pe ko e houa ʻe fiha kuo ngāueʻaki ʻi he kaati, mo ha fakafuofua ʻoku ʻikai fie maʻu, ngaahi fakaʻilonga Totongi mo Laka Taimi pea mo ha lekooti ʻaho ki he ʻaho pe ko hai naʻe ngāue ʻo fēfē hono lōloa. ʻOku ʻave ʻa e fika kakato ki he ngaahi vīsone taimi, kavenga ngāue mo e totongi ʻo e papa, pea ʻoku tānaki ki ai ʻe he ngaahi uasi Flowtime mo e Pomodoro ʻi heni.
help-card-time-how-it-works-description: Lomiʻi ʻa e fakaʻilonga taimi pe ko e hamipeka ʻi he tafaʻaki ʻo e Taimi kuo ngāueʻaki ke fakaava ʻa e Liliu taimi kuo ngāueʻaki, tohi ʻa e ngaahi houa (ʻoku ngofua ʻa e ngaahi kongakonga), pea ʻo kapau ʻoku ke loto ha fakafuofua mo e ngaahi fakaʻilonga, pea Tauhi. ʻI lalo ʻi he Taimi ʻi he ʻaho, fili ha ʻaho, tohi ʻa e ngaahi houa mo ha fakamatala pea lomiʻi ʻa e Tohi taimi; ʻe lava ke ke toʻo hoʻo meʻa pē ʻaʻau kae ʻoua kuo tali pe kuo ʻinivoisi. ʻOku kulokula ʻa e fakaʻilonga ʻo ka fakaʻilongaʻi ʻa e Laka Taimi.
help-card-custom-fields-what-it-is-descr: Ko e Ngaahi malaʻe fakatāutaha ko e ngaahi malaʻe lahi ange ʻoʻona pē ʻo e papa ki hono ngaahi kaati, ʻi he tafaʻaki ʻo e ngaahi malaʻe kuo ʻi ai: ha paaki, ha patiseti, ha kasitomaa, ha puha fakaʻilonga pe ha fili mei ha lisi. ʻOku fakamatalaʻi tuʻo taha pē kinautolu ki he papa, pea ʻe lava leva ʻe he kaati taki taha ʻo tauhi hono mahuʻinga ʻoʻona pē.
help-card-custom-fields-how-it-works-des: ʻI heni ʻoku ke fili ai pe ko e fē ʻo e ngaahi malaʻe fakatāutaha ʻo e papa ʻoku ngāueʻaki ʻe he kaati ni pea fakafonu honau ngaahi mahuʻinga. ʻOku ngaohi ʻa e ngaahi malaʻe foʻou ʻi he Ngaahi fokotuʻutuʻu ʻo e Papa ʻi he Kaati, ʻi he konga Ngaahi malaʻe fakatāutaha, ʻaki hono fili ha hingoa mo ha faʻahinga hangē ko e Tohi, Fika, ʻAho, Lisi tō hifo, Puha fakaʻilonga pe Paʻanga. ʻE lava foki ke fakahaaʻi ha malaʻe ʻi he kaati siʻi, pea ʻe lava ke tānaki fakataha ʻa e ngaahi malaʻe fika ʻi ʻolunga ʻi he lisi taki taha.
help-card-planning-poker-what-it-is-desc: ʻOku tuku ʻe he Poka Palani ke fakafuofua fakataha ʻe he timi ha kaati. ʻOku fili ʻe he taha kotoa ha mahuʻinga mei he kaati vaʻinga taʻe sio ki he fili ʻa e niʻihi kehe, pea ʻo ka ʻosi ʻa e fili ʻoku fakahaaʻi ʻe he WeKan pe ko hai naʻa ne fili ʻa e hā pea ko e fē mahuʻinga naʻe ikuna, ko ia ʻoku loto taha ki he fakafuofua kae ʻikai mahuʻi ʻe ha tokotaha pē.
help-card-planning-poker-how-it-works-de: Fakaava ʻa e hamipeka ʻo e konga, Fakatonutonu ʻa e Poka Palani, ʻo kapau ʻoku ke loto tuku ki he kau ngāueʻaki kotoa kuo hū ki loto pea fokotuʻu ha taimi ngata, pea Tauhi. ʻOku lomiʻi ʻe he tokotaha fili taki taha ha mahuʻinga ʻe taha; ko hono lomiʻi ha taha kehe ʻoku ne liliu ʻa e fili. ʻOku lomiʻi ʻe ha pule ʻo e papa ʻa e Fakaʻosi ke sio ki he ngaahi ola, tohi ha fika pea lomiʻi ʻa e Fokotuʻu Fakafuofua. ʻOku fakamaʻa ʻe he Toe Vaʻinga ʻa e ngaahi fili ki ha takai foʻou.
help-card-scrum-what-it-is-description: ʻOku tauhi ʻe he Ngaahi fokotuʻutuʻu Scrum ʻa e feituʻu ʻo e kaati ʻi he palani Scrum ʻo e papa: hono sipulingi mo e ngaahi sipulingi kuo ʻosi, tukuange, faʻahinga palopalema, ngaahi fie maʻu ke tali mo e tuʻunga ʻi he lisi tatali. ʻE lava foki ke fakaʻilongaʻi ʻa e kaati ko ha Talanoa pe ha Ngāue, ʻa ia ʻoku ngāueʻaki ʻe he ngaahi vīsone sipulingi mo e lisi tatali.
help-card-scrum-how-it-works-description: Fakaava ʻa e Fakatonutonu ʻi lalo ʻi he ngaahi malaʻe ke liliu kinautolu pea Tauhi; ko kinautolu pē ʻoku ngofua ke nau liliu ʻa e kaati ʻe lava ʻo fakatonutonu. ʻOku fili ʻe he hamipeka ʻi he ʻulu ʻo e konga ʻa e faʻahinga kaati: ʻikai, Talanoa pe Ngāue. ʻOku palani, kamata mo tāpuni ʻa e ngaahi sipulingi tonu ʻi he ngaahi vīsone Scrum ʻo e papa, pea ʻoku fokotuʻu ʻi he Ngaahi fokotuʻutuʻu ʻo e Papa ʻi he Kaati pe ko e fē ʻo e ngaahi malaʻe ni ʻoku hā.
help-card-description-what-it-is-descrip: Ko e fakamatala ko e tohi tefito ia ʻo e kaati: ko e ngaahi fakaikiiki ʻo e ngāue, ngaahi tohi nounou, fehokotakiʻanga pe ngaahi miniti fakataha kuo pipiki. ʻOku tohi ia ʻi he Markdown, ko ia ʻe lava ke ʻi ai ha ngaahi ʻulu, lisi, fehokotakiʻanga, ngaahi ʻimoji mo e ʻīmisi kae kei tohi angamaheni pē ke fakatonutonu.
help-card-description-how-it-works-descr: Lomiʻi ʻa e fakamatala ke fakatonutonu ia ʻi ha puha tohi angamaheni. Tohi ʻa e fakaʻilonga at mo e kamataʻanga ʻo ha hingoa ke maʻu ha ngaahi fokotuʻu mēmipa. Tauhi, pea ʻoku fakahaaʻi ʻa e tohi kuo fokotuʻu fakaʻofoʻofa. ʻOku nofo ʻa e ngaahi faile kuo hiki hake ʻi he konga Ngaahi meʻa fakapipiki pea ʻe lava ke lave ki ai mei he tohi.
help-card-checklists-what-it-is-descript: Ko ha lisi sivi ko ha lisi ia ʻo ha ngaahi meʻa ʻi he kaati, ʻoku fakaʻilongaʻi taki taha ʻo ka ʻosi, ki ha ngaahi sitepu, ngaahi fie maʻu ke tali pe ha founga angamaheni. ʻE lava ke maʻu ʻe ha kaati ha ngaahi lisi sivi lahi, pea ʻe lava ke fakahaaʻi ʻe he kaati siʻi pe ko e meʻa ʻe fiha kuo ʻosi.
help-card-checklists-how-it-works-descri: Tānaki ha lisi sivi ʻaki hono fakaʻilonga tānaki, pea tānaki ha ngaahi meʻa pea fakaʻilongaʻi kinautolu ʻo ka ʻosi. ʻOku ʻi he hamipeka ʻoʻona pē ʻo e lisi sivi taki taha hono ngaahi ngāue: fakatonutonu ʻa e ngaahi meʻa kotoa ʻi he taimi tatau ko ha tohi, ʻave pe ʻomi ki loto, hiki pe hiki tatau ia, fakaʻilongaʻi pe toʻo ʻa e fakaʻilonga ʻo e ngaahi meʻa kotoa, fufū ʻa e ngaahi meʻa kuo fakaʻilongaʻi, fokotuʻu ha toe kamata fakaʻotomētiki ʻoku ne toʻo ʻa e fakaʻilonga ʻo e meʻa kotoa ʻi he ʻaho, uike pe māhina taki taha, pe tāmateʻi ia. ʻE lava foki ke maʻu ʻe ha lisi sivi hano ʻaho ngataʻanga ʻoʻona pē.
help-card-subtasks-what-it-is-descriptio: ʻOku vahevahe ʻe he Ngaahi ngāue iiki ha kaati lahi ki ha ngaahi kaati iiki ange ʻe lava ke tuku, palani mo hiki taki taha, kae lisi kinautolu ʻe he kaati faʻē ni pea lau pe ko e fiha kuo ʻosi. Ko ha ngāue siʻi ko ha kaati angamaheni pē ia, ʻoku tauhi ʻi he papa kuo fili ki he ngaahi ngāue iiki.
help-card-subtasks-how-it-works-descript: Lomiʻi ʻa e fakaʻilonga tānaki, tohi ha kaveinga pea Tauhi ke ngaohi ha ngāue siʻi; fakaʻilongaʻi ʻa e Tukufakaholo ʻa e ngaahi fakaʻilonga ʻo e faʻē ke hiki tatau ʻa e ngaahi fakaʻilonga ʻo e kaati ni ki ai. ʻOku tānaki ʻe he fakaʻilonga fehokotakiʻanga ha kaati ʻoku ʻi ai ko ha ngāue siʻi ʻi hono fetongi. ʻOku ʻi he hamipeka ʻo e ngāue siʻi taki taha ʻa e Sio ki ai, ʻAlu ki he Papa pea, ki he kau pule ʻo e papa, Tāmateʻi. Lomiʻi ʻa e kaveinga ʻo ha ngāue siʻi ke liliu hono hingoa.
help-card-attachments-what-it-is-descrip: Ko e Ngaahi meʻa fakapipiki ko e ngaahi faile ia ʻoku tauhi mo e kaati: ngaahi tohi, ʻīmisi, vitiō, lekooti pe ngaahi tauhiʻanga faile. ʻE lava foki ke hoko ha ʻīmisi ko e tā kava ʻoku fakahaaʻi ʻi he kaati siʻi.
help-card-attachments-how-it-works-descr: Lomiʻi ʻa e fakaʻilonga tānaki ke tānaki ha ngaahi faile mei hoʻo komipiuta, pipiki pe tukutuku ha ʻīmisi, pipiki ha kaati kehe, pe tā ha tā foʻou. ʻOku fakahaaʻi ʻi lalo ʻi he ngaahi fili ni ha fakangatangata lahi pē mo e ngaahi faʻahinga faile ʻoku ngofua. Lomiʻi ha meʻa fakapipiki ke fakaava ia ʻi he fakaʻaliʻali tā, pea ngāueʻaki ʻa e ngaahi meʻa lomiʻi ʻi hono tafaʻaki ke hiki hifo, liliu hingoa pe tāmateʻi ia; ʻoku ʻi hono hamipeka ʻa e ngaahi fili ʻīmisi kava.
help-card-comments-what-it-is-descriptio: Ko e Ngaahi fakamatala ko e fepōtalanoaʻaki ia ʻo e kaati: ngaahi fehuʻi, tali, fakafoʻou mo e ngaahi tuʻutuʻuni, ʻoku tauhi mo e ngāue ʻoku nau kau ki ai. ʻE lava ʻe ha fakamatala ʻo tali ha fakamatala ki muʻa, pea ʻoku fakahaaʻi ʻa e tali ʻi lalo ai ko ha hokohoko.
help-card-comments-how-it-works-descript: Tohi ʻi he malaʻe fakamatala, ʻo ngāueʻaki ʻa e Markdown mo lave ki ha kakai ʻaki ʻa e fakaʻilonga at, pea ʻave ia. Lomiʻi ʻa e Tali ʻi he tafaʻaki ʻo ha fakamatala ke tali ia; ʻoku fakahaaʻi ʻe ha fuka Tali ki ai ʻa e meʻa ʻoku ke tali, pea ko hono tāpuni ia ʻoku ngaohi ha fakamatala angamaheni. ʻE lava ke ke fakatonutonu pe tāmateʻi hoʻo ngaahi fakamatala pē ʻaʻau, pea ʻi ha ngaahi papa ko e tokotaha tohi pē ʻo ha fakamatala ʻe lava ke ne liliu ia.
help-card-stickers-what-it-is-descriptio: Ko e Ngaahi sitika ko e ngaahi kiʻi fakaʻilonga ia ʻoku tuku ki ha kaati, hangē ko ha motuʻaniʻima ki ʻolunga, ha kiʻi manu, ha uasi pe ha ipu ikuna, ke fakaʻilongaʻi ia ʻi ha sio pē taʻe ngāueʻaki ha fakaʻilonga pe ha lanu. ʻOku fakahaaʻi kinautolu ʻi he kaati siʻi pea ʻi he kaati kuo fakaava.
help-card-stickers-how-it-works-descript: Lomiʻi ha sitika ʻi he meʻa fili ke tānaki ia ki he kaati; ʻoku fakahaaʻi ʻe ha fakaʻilonga tonu ʻoku ʻi he kaati, pea ko hono toe lomiʻi ʻoku ne toʻo ia. ʻI he kaati, ʻoku toʻo ʻe he kiʻi kolosi ʻi he tafaʻaki ʻo ha sitika ia. ʻOku fie maʻu ʻe he tānaki mo e toʻo ʻa e totonu ke liliu ʻa e kaati.
help-card-locations-what-it-is-descripti: ʻE lava ke maʻu ʻe ha kaati ha ngaahi feituʻu lahi, ko e ngaahi feituʻu ʻoku fai ai ʻa e ngāue, hangē ko e ʻōfisi ʻo ha kasitomaa, ha feituʻu ngāue pe ha feituʻu fakataha. ʻOku ʻi ai ʻa e taha kotoa hano hingoa, ha tuʻasila pea, ʻo ka ʻilo, ha ngaahi tuʻunga mape mo ha fehokotakiʻanga Fakaava ʻi he mape.
help-card-locations-how-it-works-descrip: Fakafonu ʻa e hingoa ʻo e feituʻu, tuʻasila, laini ʻesi mo e laini loa pea lomiʻi ʻa e Tauhi. Ko hono pipiki ha fehokotakiʻanga mape ʻoku ʻiloʻi ai ʻe he puha ʻa e feituʻu maʻau, ko ia ʻoku ʻikai fie maʻu ke tohi ʻe ha taha ʻa e ngaahi tuʻunga mape. Ko hono lomiʻi ha feituʻu ʻi he kaati ʻoku toe fakaava ia ke liliu pe tāmateʻi, pea ʻoku toʻo leva ia ʻe he kolosi ʻi hono tafaʻaki.
help-card-dependencies-what-it-is-descri: ʻOku fakahokohoko ʻe he Ngaahi fehokotakiʻanga ʻa e kaati ni ki ha ngaahi kaati kehe: ʻoku ne taʻofi, ʻoku taʻofi ia ʻe, ʻoku ne fakatonutonu, ʻoku ne tatau mo pe ʻoku fekauʻaki mo kinautolu. ʻO ka fakaʻaliʻali ʻa e ngaahi fehokotakiʻanga ʻi he Ngaahi fokotuʻutuʻu ʻa e Mēmipa, ʻoku tā kinautolu ko ha ngaahi laine ngahau lanu ʻi he papa, ko ia ʻoku hā mahino ʻa e hokohoko ʻo e ngāue ʻi ha sio pē.
help-card-dependencies-how-it-works-desc: Fili ʻa e faʻahinga fehokotaki mo ha lanu, pea kumi mo lomiʻi ʻa e kaati ke fehokotaki ki ai. ʻOku fakahaaʻi ʻa e fehokotakiʻanga ʻi he Ngaahi fehokotakiʻanga ʻo e kaati pea ko ha laine ʻi he papa. Lomiʻi ha laine, pe ngāueʻaki ʻa e Ngaahi fehokotakiʻanga ʻo e kaati, ke liliu hono faʻahinga, lanu pe fakaʻilonga, pe ke toʻo ia. ʻE lava foki ke ke toho ʻa e kau fehokotaki ʻo ha kaati siʻi ki ha kaati kehe.
help-card-action-items-what-it-is-descri: ʻOku liliu ʻe he Ngaahi meʻa ke fai ʻa e ngaahi laine ngāue ʻo ha ngaahi miniti fakataha kuo pipiki ki ha ngaahi kaati. Ko e ngaahi laine hangē ko e TODO: Tohi ʻa e feituʻu, ha laine ngāue teʻeki fakaʻilongaʻi, pe ha laine ʻoku kamata ʻaki ha lave ki ha taha ʻoku ʻilo ʻaki honau fōtunga, taʻe ha poto fakaʻotomētiki.
help-card-action-items-how-it-works-desc: ʻOku lisi ʻe he puha ʻa e ngaahi kaati ʻe ngaohi, taki taha mo ha fakaʻilonga tonu mo e mēmipa ʻoku tuhu ki ai ha lave. Toʻo ʻa e fakaʻilonga ʻo e meʻa ʻoku ʻikai te ke fie maʻu pea lomiʻi ʻa e Ngaohi. ʻOku ʻalu ʻa e ngaahi kaati foʻou ki he lisi tatau mo e kaati ni pea fehokotaki ki ai. ʻOku hoko ha lave ko ha mēmipa pē ʻo kapau ko e tokotaha ko ia ko ha mēmipa ngāue ʻo e papa.
help-card-history-what-it-is-description: Ko e Hisitōlia ko e lisi ia ʻo e liliu kotoa naʻe fai ki he kaati ni: ko hai naʻa ne liliu ʻa e hā, ʻi he taimi fē, pea mei he mahuʻinga fē ki he fē. ʻE lava ke fili mo fakafoki ha liliu pē, ko ia ʻe lava ke toe fakafoki ha fehalaaki neongo ki mui.
help-card-history-how-it-works-descripti: Tohi ʻi he Kumi ke fakasiʻisiʻi ʻa e ngaahi laine, pe lomiʻi ʻa e tā ʻo ha tokotaha ke sio pē ki heʻene ngaahi liliu. Fakaholo peesi ʻaki ʻa e ngaahi ngahau. Fakaʻilongaʻi ha laine ʻe taha pe lahi ange pea lomiʻi ʻa e Fakafoki; ʻoku fakafoki ʻa e ngaahi laine lahi ʻo muʻomuʻa ʻa e motuʻa taha ko ha liliu pē ʻe taha, ʻa ia ʻe lava foki ke fakafoki. ʻOku fakafoki mo toe fai foki ʻe he Ctrl+Z mo e Ctrl+Y hoʻo liliu fakamuimui pē ʻaʻau.
help-card-qr-code-what-it-is-description: ʻOku fakahaaʻi ʻe he koti QR ʻa e fehokotakiʻanga ʻo e kaati ni ko ha koti ʻe lava ke ke sikeni, ke fakaava ʻa e kaati ʻi ha telefoni pe tapuleti taʻe tohi hono tuʻasila. ʻOku ʻikai ke ne liliu ha meʻa ʻi he kaati.
help-card-qr-code-how-it-works-descripti: Tuhu ʻa e meʻa tā ʻo e telefoni ki he koti pea fakaava ʻa e fehokotakiʻanga; ʻoku fakahaaʻi foki ʻa e tuʻasila ko ha tohi ʻi lalo ai. ʻOku tā ʻa e koti ʻi hoʻo palausa pea ʻoku ʻikai ʻave ha meʻa ki ha feituʻu. Ko ia ʻoku ne sikeni ia ʻoku kei pau ke ne hū ki loto pea maʻu ha ngofua ki he papa. ʻOku lipooti ha fehokotakiʻanga ʻoku lōloa fau ki ha koti QR ʻi hono fetongi.
help-card-move-what-it-is-description: ʻOku hiki ʻe he Hiki Kaati ʻa e kaati ki ha feituʻu kehe ʻi he papa ni pe ki ha papa kehe. ʻOku ne fai ʻa e meʻa ʻoku fai ʻe he toho, pea ʻi he feituʻu foki ʻoku ʻikai aʻu ki ai ʻa e toho, hangē ko ha papa kehe pe ha feituʻu pau ʻi ha lisi lōloa.
help-card-move-how-it-works-description: Fili ʻa e papa, hala mo e lisi, pea ha kaati mo pe ʻe ʻalu ki ʻolunga pe ki lalo ʻiate ia. ʻE lava ke ke liliu ʻa e kaveinga, tohi ha ʻuhinga hiki ʻoku ʻikai fie maʻu, pea fakaʻilongaʻi ʻa e Tuku ha fehokotakiʻanga ʻi he feituʻu ʻuluaki ke tauhi ha kaati fehokotaki ʻi he feituʻu naʻe ʻi ai. Lomiʻi ʻa e Kuo ʻOsi ʻo ka hū mai ʻa e feituʻu ʻoku ʻalu ki ai. ʻOku fakaava foki ʻe he Shift+M ʻa e puha ni, pea ʻoku manatuʻi ʻa e feituʻu ʻoku ʻalu ki ai ki he papa taki taha.
help-card-copy-what-it-is-description: ʻOku ngaohi ʻe he Hiki Tatau Kaati ha tatau foʻou mo tauʻatāina ʻo e kaati ʻi he papa ni pe ha papa kehe, mo hono fika ʻoʻona pē mo hono ngaahi tatau ʻoʻona pē ʻo e ngaahi fakamatala, lisi sivi, meʻa fakapipiki mo e ngāue iiki.
help-card-copy-how-it-works-description: Fakatonutonu ʻa e kaveinga ʻo kapau ʻoku ke loto ki ai; ʻoku ʻikai hiki tatau ha meʻa ʻe ha kaveinga maha. Fili ʻa e papa, hala mo e lisi, pea ha kaati mo pe ʻe ʻalu ʻa e tatau ki ʻolunga pe ki lalo ʻiate ia, pea lomiʻi ʻa e Kuo ʻOsi. ʻO kapau ʻoku taʻe tali ʻa e hiki tatau, ʻoku fakahaaʻi ʻa e ʻuhinga ʻi heni. ʻOku fakaava foki ʻe he Shift+C ʻa e puha ni, pea ʻoku manatuʻi ʻa e feituʻu ʻoku ʻalu ki ai ki he papa taki taha.
help-card-recurrence-what-it-is-descript: ʻOku ngaohi ʻe he Toe Hoko ʻo e Kaati ke ngaohi ʻe he WeKan ha tatau foʻou ʻo e kaati ni ʻi he lisi tatau ʻo fakatatau ki ha taimi tēpile, ki ha ngāue ʻoku toe hoko hangē ko ha lipooti tuʻunga fakauike pe ha ʻinivoisi fakamāhina ʻa ia ʻe toe ngaohi ʻaki ʻa e nima.
help-card-recurrence-how-it-works-descri: Fili ʻa e Fakaʻaho, Fakauike pe Fakamāhina, pe Tāmateʻi ke taʻofi ia; ko e Tāmateʻi ʻa e tuʻumaʻu. ʻOku ngaohi leva ʻe he sēvea ʻa e ngaahi tatau ʻiate ia pē, taʻe fie maʻu ha toe fokotuʻu. Ko hono tuku ʻa e kaati ki he Tauhiʻanga ʻoku ne taʻofi foki ia mei hono ngaohi ha toe tatau, neongo ʻoku kei fokotuʻu ʻa e vahaʻa taimi.
help-card-copy-many-what-it-is-descripti: ʻOku ngaohi ʻe he Hiki Tatau Sīpinga ki ha Ngaahi Kaati Lahi ha ngaahi tatau lahi ʻo e kaati ni ʻi he taimi tatau. ʻOku ngāue ʻa e kaati ko ha sīpinga: ʻoku ʻalu hono ngaahi lisi sivi, meʻa fakapipiki, fakaʻilonga mo e ngaahi malaʻe kehe ki he tatau kotoa, pea ko e kaveinga mo e fakamatala pē ʻoku kehekehe.
help-card-copy-many-how-it-works-descrip: ʻI he puha tohi, tohi ha meʻa ʻe taha ki he kaati taki taha mo hono kaveinga mo e fakamatala, ʻo muimui ki he sīpinga kuo ʻosi fakafonu. Fili ʻa e papa, hala, lisi mo e feituʻu ʻi he tafaʻaki ʻo ha kaati, pea lomiʻi ʻa e Kuo ʻOsi. ʻO kapau ʻoku ʻikai ʻi he founga totonu ʻa e tohi, ʻoku ʻikai ngaohi ha meʻa pea ʻoku fakahaaʻi ʻa e fehalaaki ʻi heni.
help-card-color-what-it-is-description: ʻOku ʻoatu ʻe he Fokotuʻu lanu ki he kaati ha lanu puipuituʻa ʻoʻona pē ke hā mahino ʻi he papa, hangē ko e kulokula ki he ngāue fakavavevave pe ko e lanu ʻoʻona pē ʻo ha kasitomaa. ʻOku ngaohi fakaʻotomētiki ʻa e tohi ʻo e kaati ke lava ʻo lau ʻi he lanu.
help-card-color-how-it-works-description: Lomiʻi ha taha ʻo e ngaahi lanu kuo fakahingoa, ha lanu fakatāutaha kuo ngāueʻaki ʻi he papa ni, pe fili ha lanu pē ʻi lalo ʻi he Lanu fakatāutaha, pea lomiʻi ʻa e Tauhi. ʻOku toʻo ʻe he Toʻo ʻa e lanu. ʻOku hā ʻa e lanu ʻi he kaati siʻi pea ʻi he kaati kuo fakaava, kae ʻoua kuo tāmateʻi ʻi he Ngaahi fokotuʻutuʻu ʻo e Papa ʻi he Kaati.
help-card-drawing-what-it-is-description: ʻOku tuku ʻe he Tā Fakatātā ke ke tā pe tohi nima ʻi he kaati ʻaki ha kumā, ha tuhu pe ha peni: ha tā fakavavevave, ha tā fakatātā, ha fakamoʻoni hingoa pe ha fakamatala tohi nima. ʻOku kei lava ke fakatonutonu ʻa e tā pea ʻoku tauhi foki hono ʻīmisi ko ha meʻa fakapipiki ʻo e kaati.
help-card-drawing-how-it-works-descripti: Fili ha lanu mo ha fālahi laine pea tā. ʻOku foki ki mui ʻa e Fakafoki, ʻoku toʻo ʻe he Holoholo ʻa e ngaahi laine ʻoku ne ala ki ai pea ʻoku toʻo ʻe he Fakamaʻa ʻa e kotoa. ʻOku tauhi ʻe he Tauhi ʻa e ngaahi laine ʻi he kaati pea tauhi ʻa e ʻīmisi ko ha meʻa fakapipiki; ʻoku hoko ha tā foʻou ko e ʻīmisi kava ʻo e kaati. ʻOku lisi ʻi heni ʻa e ngaahi tā kuo tauhi ke toe fakaava mo fakatonutonu, pea ʻoku tauhi ʻe he Hiki hifo ko e SVG ha taha ko ha faile.
help-card-more-what-it-is-description: ʻOku fakahaaʻi ʻe he Lahi Ange ʻa e fehokotakiʻanga ʻo e kaati, hono ngaahi kaati faʻē mo e taimi naʻe ngaohi ai. Ko e feituʻu ia ʻoku ngaohi ai ʻa e kaati ko ha ngāue siʻi ʻo ha kaati kehe, pea ʻoku tāmateʻi ʻaupito ai ʻe ha pule ʻo e papa ʻa e kaati.
help-card-more-how-it-works-description: ʻOku hiki tatau ʻe he Hiki tatau ʻa e fehokotakiʻanga kaati ki he meʻa tauhi fakataimi ʻa e tuʻasila ʻo e kaati. ʻI lalo ʻi he Liliu ʻa e faʻē ʻo e kaati, fili ha papa matavai mo ha kaati faʻē, pe ʻikai ke toe ngaohi ia ko ha kaati tuʻunga ʻolunga; ʻoku tānaki ʻe he Tānaki ha kaati faʻē kehe ha ngaahi faʻē lahi ange, pea ʻoku toʻo ʻe he kolosi ʻi he tafaʻaki ʻo ha taha ia. ʻOku toʻo ʻaupito ʻe he Tāmateʻi, ki he kau pule ʻo e papa pē, ʻa e kaati hili ha fakapapauʻi.
help-card-create-board-what-it-is-descri: ʻOku liliu ʻe he Ngaohi papa mei he kaati ni ʻa e kaati ki ha fehokotakiʻanga ki ha papa foʻou. ʻOku maʻa ha kaati kuo tupu ko ha poloseki ʻoʻona pē: ʻoku hiki ʻa e ngāue ki hono papa ʻoʻona pē, pea ʻoku nofo ʻa e kaati ʻi he feituʻu naʻe ʻi ai ko e hala ke hū ki ai.
help-card-create-board-how-it-works-desc: ʻOku fakafonu ʻa e hingoa ʻo e papa foʻou ʻaki ʻa e kaveinga ʻo e kaati; liliu ia ʻo kapau ʻoku ke loto ki ai pea lomiʻi ʻa e Ngaohi papa mei he kaati ni. ʻOku ngaohi ʻa e papa mo koe ko hono pule, pea ʻoku fakaava leva ʻe he kaati ʻa e papa ko ia. ʻOku ʻikai liliu ha meʻa kehe ʻi he kaati. ʻO kapau ʻoku taʻe tali, ʻoku fakahaaʻi ʻa e ʻuhinga pea ʻoku ʻikai liliu ha meʻa.
help-card-link-to-board-what-it-is-descr: ʻOku tuku ʻe he Fehokotaki ki he papa ha kaati fehokotaki ʻo e kaati ni ki ha papa kehe ʻoku ʻi ai. ʻOku hā leva ʻa e kaati ʻi he ongo papa: ʻoku nofo ʻa e kaati ʻuluaki ʻi he feituʻu ʻoku ʻi ai, pea ʻoku fakahaaʻi ʻe he fehokotakiʻanga hono meʻa ʻi he feituʻu naʻa ke tuku ai.
help-card-link-to-board-how-it-works-des: Fili ʻa e papa, hala mo e lisi, pea ha kaati mo pe ʻe ʻalu ʻa e fehokotakiʻanga ki ʻolunga pe ki lalo ʻiate ia, pea lomiʻi ʻa e Kuo ʻOsi. ʻI ha lisi maha ʻoku ʻalu ʻa e fehokotakiʻanga ki lalo taha. ʻOku ʻikai liliu ʻa e kaati ʻuluaki, pea ʻoku ʻikai hiki tatau ʻa e ngaahi fakaʻilonga. ʻOku manatuʻi ʻa e feituʻu ʻoku ʻalu ki ai ki he papa taki taha.
help-card-actions-what-it-is-description: ʻOku tānaki ʻe he lisi fili hamipeka ʻo e kaati, Ngaahi Ngāue ʻo e Kaati, ʻa e meʻa kotoa ʻe lava ke ke fai ki he kaati kakato, kae ʻikai ki ha taha ʻo hono ngaahi malaʻe. ʻOku fakatuʻunga ʻa e ngaahi meʻa ʻoku hā ʻi ho fatongia ʻi he papa.
help-card-actions-how-it-works-descripti: ʻOku ʻi he Hiki mo hiki tatau ʻa e Hiki Kaati, Hiki Tatau Kaati, Tauhi ko ha Sīpinga, Hiki Tatau Sīpinga ki ha Ngaahi Kaati Lahi, Toe Hoko ʻo e Kaati mo hono hiki ki ʻolunga taha pe ki lalo taha ʻo e lisi. Hoko ai ʻa e Siofi mo e Fetuʻu, pea mo e Fōtunga mo e Fokotuʻu lanu, Tā Fakatātā mo e Ngaohi kaati mei he ngaahi meʻa ke fai. ʻOku ʻi he Vahevahe ʻa e fehokotakiʻanga kaati, Fehokotaki ki he papa, koti QR mo e Hisitōlia, pea mo e ʻAve mo e ʻOmi ki loto. ʻOku ʻi he Tauhiʻanga ʻa e Tuku kaati ki he Tauhiʻanga, Lahi Ange mo e Ngaohi papa mei he kaati ni.
help-admin-version-what-it-is-descriptio: ʻOku fakahaaʻi ʻe he konga Paaki ʻa e meʻa ʻoku lele ʻi he WeKan ni: ko e paaki WeKan mo e founga naʻe fokotuʻu ai, ko e polokalama tefito, Meteor, ko e tauhiʻanga fakamatala mo e Node.js. Ko e ʻuluaki konga ia ʻo e Palanisi ʻo e pule ʻi he Ngaahi fokotuʻutuʻu pea ko e fakamatala ke hiki tatau ki ha lipooti palopalema ʻo ka kole tokoni.
help-admin-version-how-it-works-descript: Lau ʻa e tēpile, ʻa ia kuo fakakulupu ki he Tuʻunga, Polokalama tefito, Meteor, Tauhiʻanga fakamatala mo e Node. Lomiʻi ʻa e Sivi Paaki ke fakahoa mo e ngaahi paaki foʻou taha kuo tukuange ʻo e WeKan, FerretDB, Meteor, Node mo e NPM; lolotonga ʻene lele ʻoku ne pehē ʻoku hū mai, pea kapau ʻoku hala ʻa e sivi ʻoku ke sio ki ha pōpoaki hala pē ʻe taha ʻi hono fetongi.
help-admin-appearance-what-it-is-descrip: ʻOku fili ʻe he Fōtunga ʻa e founga ʻoku hā ai ʻa e WeKan ni mo e meʻa ʻoku fakahaaʻi ʻe he Ngaahi papa kotoa: ngaahi konga fufū hangē ko e ngaahi papa fakapuleʻanga pe ngaahi ngāue papa, ko hai ʻe lava ʻo ngaohi papa, founga ʻaho, fālahi ʻo e ava ʻa e fakaikiiki kaati, ngaahi tuʻasila fehokotakiʻanga, fehokotaki fakaʻotomētiki ki ha meʻangāue muimui palopalema kehe, hingoa ʻo e koloa, ngaahi lanu mo e ngaahi lōko.
help-admin-appearance-how-it-works-descr: Liliu ʻa e ngaahi malaʻe ʻo ha kulupu ʻe taha pea lomiʻi ʻa e Tauhi ʻoʻona pē ʻo e kulupu ko ia, ʻa ia ʻoku ne tauhi pē ʻa e kulupu ko ia. Ko e ngaahi fakaʻilonga ʻi lalo ʻi he Ngaahi papa kotoa: Fufū ʻoku ʻuhinga ʻoku fufū ʻa e meʻa, tukukehe ʻa e ngaahi papa ʻe lava ʻe he tokotaha kotoa kuo hū ki loto ʻo fakatonutonu, ʻa ia ʻoku fakaʻilongaʻi ʻo ka ngofua. ʻOku tauhi ʻe he Liliu lanu taʻe ha meʻa lomiʻi Tauhi pea ko e kulupu pē ia ʻoku sio ki ai ʻa e pule ʻoʻona pē ʻo ha kautaha.
help-admin-features-what-it-is-descripti: Ko e Ngaahi Meʻa ko e feituʻu ia ʻoku fakaʻaliʻali pe tāmateʻi ai ʻe ha pule ʻo e saiti ʻa e ngaahi konga ʻoku ʻikai fie maʻu ʻo e WeKan ki he fokotuʻu kakato: ngaahi vīsone papa, meʻa tokoni, meʻangāue Kanban mo e Scrum, ngaahi malaʻe kaati, Kavenga ngāue mo e malava, Patiseti mo e totongi, SQRL, ActivityPub, Ngaahi tuʻutuʻuni lau pē mo e ngaahi API fehoanaki ʻoku ʻikai fie maʻu. ʻOku ʻi ai maʻu pē ʻa e ngaahi hala mo e lisi.
help-admin-features-how-it-works-descrip: Toʻo ʻa e fakaʻilonga ʻo e meʻa ʻoku ʻikai totonu ke ʻoatu ʻe he WeKan ni, kau ai ʻa e ngaahi malaʻe kaati ʻoku ʻikai totonu ke fakahaaʻi ʻe ha papa, pea lomiʻi ʻa e Tauhi. ʻOku mole ha meʻa kuo toʻo hono fakaʻilonga mei he fakafeʻiloaki ʻa e taha kotoa pea ʻoku taʻe tali foki ia ʻe he sēvea, ka ʻoku tauhi hono fakamatala. ʻE lava ke ke fie maʻu ha tali ki he ngaahi meʻa ʻoku tānaki ʻe ha fakafoʻou WeKan, pea fakahingoa ha kau ngāueʻaki sivi ʻoku kei sio ki he ngaahi meʻa kuo tāmateʻi.
help-admin-feature-profiles-what-it-is-d: ʻOku ʻoatu ʻe ha palōfila meʻa ki he kau ngāueʻaki, timi pe kautaha kuo fili ha WeKan siʻi ange ʻaki hono fufū ha ngaahi meʻa ʻoku ʻikai fie maʻu meiate kinautolu, kae kei sio ʻa e taha kotoa kehe ki he meʻa kotoa. ʻE lava ke ne fufū ʻa e ngaahi meʻa tatau ʻe lava ʻe he konga Ngaahi Meʻa ʻo tāmateʻi.
help-admin-feature-profiles-how-it-works: Lomiʻi ʻa e Tānaki palōfila, ʻoatu hano hingoa, fakaʻilongaʻi ʻa e ngaahi meʻa ʻoku ne fufū pea lisi hono kau ngāueʻaki, timi mo e kautaha, pea lomiʻi ʻa e Tauhi ʻo e konga. ʻOku lipooti ʻa e ngaahi hingoa naʻe ʻikai hoa mo ha taha hili hono tauhi pea ʻoku ʻikai tauhi. ʻOku sivi ʻa e ngaahi palōfila ʻi he hokohoko ʻo e peesi, pea ʻoku tala ʻe he lisi fili mēmipa ʻa e tokotaha ngāueʻaki pe ko e fē palōfila ʻoku ne fufū ʻa e meʻa ʻe fiha.
help-admin-security-what-it-is-descripti: ʻOku tauhi ʻe he Malu ʻa e ngaahi meʻa liliu ki he sēvea kakato ki he meʻa ʻe lava ke fai ʻe he tohi faʻu mo e meʻa ʻe lava ke ʻomi ki loto pe ʻave. Ngāueʻaki kinautolu ke taʻofi ʻa e ngaahi fehokotakiʻanga ʻe lava ke lomiʻi, fakahaaʻi ʻa e tohi faʻu kotoa ko e matavai angamaheni, taʻofi ʻa e ʻomi ki loto pe ʻave, fakangatangata ʻa e lahi ʻo e ʻomi ki loto, tuku ki tuʻa ʻa e ngaahi tā, pe fetongi ʻa e ngaahi ʻilo moʻoni ʻo e kau ngāueʻaki ʻaki ha ngaahi hingoa taʻe ʻiloa.
help-admin-security-how-it-works-descrip: Fakaʻilongaʻi ha meʻa liliu pea ʻoku tauhi leva ia; ʻoku tauhi ʻa e lahi taha ʻo e ʻomi ki loto ʻo ka ke mavahe mei he malaʻe, pea ko ha mahuʻinga maha ʻoku ʻuhinga ʻoku ʻikai ha fakangatangata. ʻOku tāmateʻi ʻa e meʻa liliu kotoa ʻi he tuʻumaʻu pea ʻoku fakamālohiʻi ʻe he sēvea, ko ia ʻoku taʻe tali ha ʻomi ki loto pe ʻave kuo tāmateʻi neongo ʻoku ui hangatonu ia ʻe ha taha.
help-admin-activities-what-it-is-descrip: Ko ha meʻa liliu ʻe tolu ki he sēvea kakato ki he ngaahi saiti ʻoku pau ke fakangatangata ʻa e muimui ngāue: taʻofi hono tohi pe ko hai naʻa ne fai ʻa e hā, taʻofi hono ʻave ʻo e ngaahi fakatokanga ki he ngaahi ngāue, pe taʻofi ʻa e kau ngāueʻaki mei hono siofi ʻa e ngaahi papa, lisi mo e kaati.
help-admin-activities-how-it-works-descr: Fakaʻilongaʻi ha meʻa liliu pea ʻoku tauhi leva ia. ʻO ka tāmateʻi ʻa e ngaahi ngāue, ʻoku ʻikai tohi ha meʻa foʻou pea ʻoku ʻikai toe fakahaaʻi ʻa e ngaahi meʻa ʻoku ʻi ai. ʻO ka tāmateʻi ʻa e ngaahi fakatokanga, ʻoku ʻikai ʻave ha fakatokanga ʻi loto, ʻīmeili pe kehe. ʻO ka tāmateʻi ʻa e siofi, ʻoku ʻikai lava ʻe ha taha ʻo liliu ha tuʻunga siofi. Toʻo ʻa e fakaʻilonga ke toe fakaʻaliʻali ia; ʻoku ʻikai toe foki mai ʻa e ngaahi ngāue naʻe ʻikai tohi ʻi he vahaʻa taimi ko ia.
help-admin-delete-what-it-is-description: ʻOku angamaheni ʻa e tāmateʻi ʻi he WeKan ʻo fakaʻilongaʻi pē ʻa e ngaahi lisi, kaati mo e meʻa fakapipiki kuo tāmateʻi ko ia ʻe lava ke fakafoki. ʻOku tauhi ʻe he konga ni ʻa e meʻa liliu pē ʻe taha ʻoku ne tuku ke fakaʻauha ʻaupito ʻe ha pule ʻo e saiti ha meʻa pehē.
help-admin-delete-how-it-works-descripti: Fakaʻilongaʻi ʻa e Fakaʻaliʻali ʻa e tāmateʻi taʻengata ki he Pule Lahi; ʻoku tauhi leva ia pea ʻoku ʻikai tāmateʻi ha meʻa ʻiate ia pē. ʻOku hā leva ʻa e ngaahi fakaʻilonga tāmateʻi ʻi he feituʻu ʻoku ʻoatu ai ʻa e tāmateʻi taʻengata, hangē ko ha lisi ʻi he kapaʻi veve pe ha papa ʻi he Tauhiʻanga ʻo e Ngaahi papa kotoa. ʻOku tohi ʻa e liliu fokotuʻu kotoa mo e feinga tāmateʻi taʻengata kotoa ʻi he Fakafoki. Toʻo hono fakaʻilonga ʻo ka ke ʻosi.
help-admin-announcement-what-it-is-descr: Ko ha fuka ki he saiti kakato ke tala ki he tokotaha ngāueʻaki kotoa kuo hū ki loto ha meʻa ʻi he taimi tatau, hangē ko ha mālōlō tauhi, ha tuʻasila foʻou pe ha liliu tuʻutuʻuni. ʻOku kehe ia mei he fanongonongo ʻoʻona pē ʻo ha papa.

help-admin-pwa-how-it-works-description: Fakaʻilongaʻi ʻa e konga ʻoku ke fie fakatāutahaʻi, ʻa ia ʻoku tauhi leva, pipiki hoʻo ngaahi fakaʻilonga pe JSON pea lomiʻi ʻa e Tauhi. ʻOku taʻe tali ha JSON hala pea ʻoku ʻikai tauhi ha meʻa. ʻOku tānaki pē ʻa e ngaahi fakaʻilonga meta ko ha ngaahi konga meta, ko ia ʻoku liʻaki ʻa e ngaahi sikilipi, fōtunga mo e ngaahi fakaʻilonga fakafoʻou peesi. ʻO ka tāmateʻi ha meʻa liliu, ʻoku ngāueʻaki ʻe he WeKan hono ngaahi tuʻumaʻu kuo ʻi ai.

help-admin-global-webhooks-how-it-works-: Fakafonu ʻa e foomu maha ʻaki ha hingoa, ʻa e tuʻasila, ha tokeni ʻoku ʻikai fie maʻu mo e faʻahinga, founga taha pe founga ua, pea lomiʻi ʻa e Ngaohi. ʻI ha uepihuki kuo tauhi ʻe lava ke ke tāmateʻi ia, fili pe ko e fē ngaahi ngāue ʻoku ne ʻave mo e founga ʻoku ne ʻave ai, pea Tauhi. help-admin-shared-templates-what-it-is-d: ʻOku tuku ʻe he Ngaahi sīpinga fevahevaheʻaki ke ke vakai ki he ngaahi papa sīpinga ʻe lava ke vahevahe ʻa e kau ngāueʻaki ʻaki ʻa e kautaha, timi pe tuʻasila ʻīmeili. ʻOku fili foki ʻe he ngaahi fakaʻilonga pe ko e fē faʻahinga kulupu ʻe lava ke vahevahe ki ai ha papa sīpinga mei he Ngaahi papa kotoa ʻi he Ngaahi sīpinga.
help-admin-shared-templates-how-it-works: Fakaʻilongaʻi ʻa e Ngaahi Kautaha, Ngaahi Timi pe Ngaahi Tuʻasila; ʻoku tauhi leva ʻa e fakaʻilonga taki taha ki he fokotuʻu kakato. ʻI lalo ʻi he feituʻu kuo fakaʻilongaʻi taki taha ʻoku ke sio ki he kulupu kotoa, hono kau ngāueʻaki mo ʻenau ngaahi papa sīpinga, pea ko hono lomiʻi ha papa sīpinga ʻoku ne fakaava ia. ʻOku fokotuʻu ki he kautaha mo e timi taki taha ʻi honau konga ʻoʻonautolu pē pe ʻoku aʻu ʻa e ngaahi sīpinga ʻo ha kulupu ki hono kau mēmipa.
help-admin-login-what-it-is-description: ʻOku fili ʻe he Hū ki loto ʻa e meʻa ʻoku ngofua ʻi he hū ki loto, hangē ko e ngalo ʻa e lea fufū, lesisita fakafoʻituitui, liliu hingoa ngāueʻaki, tāmateʻi hono ʻakauni pē ʻoʻona mo e meʻa fili founga. ʻOku tuku foki ʻe ia ke ke fetongi ʻa e ngaahi fokotuʻutuʻu hū ki loto ʻo e sēvea taʻe toe kamata, hangē ko e hū ki loto ʻaki ʻa e lea fufū, founga tuʻumaʻu, lōloa ʻo e fakataha, hū ki tuʻa fakaʻotomētiki, ngaahi tuʻutuʻuni lea fufū mo e fakapapauʻi founga ua fakamaʻumaʻua.
help-admin-login-how-it-works-descriptio: Fakaʻilongaʻi pe toʻo ʻa e fakaʻilonga ʻo e ngaahi puha Hū ki loto: Tuku; ʻoku tauhi ʻa e taha kotoa ʻi hono lomiʻi. ʻO ka tāmateʻi ʻa e lesisita fakafoʻituitui, ngāueʻaki ʻa e Fakaafe Kakai ke fakaafe ha ngaahi tuʻasila ki ha ngaahi papa kuo fili. ʻI he foomu fokotuʻutuʻu ʻoku tala ʻe he malaʻe taki taha pe ko e fē mahuʻinga ʻoku ngāue; tohi pe fili ha mahuʻinga pea tauhi, pe tuku ia ke maha pe fili ʻa e Tuʻumaʻu ke foki ki he ngaahi fokotuʻutuʻu ʻo e sēvea. ʻOku ʻi ai ʻa e founga hū ki loto taki taha hono konga ʻoʻona pē ʻi he lisi fili Kakai.
help-admin-saml-what-it-is-description: ʻOku tuku ʻe he hū ki loto SAML ke hū ʻa e kakai ʻi he tokotaha ʻoatu ʻilo ʻo hoʻo kautaha kae ʻikai ko ha lea fufū WeKan. ʻOku fakapapauʻi ʻe he tokotaha ʻoatu pe ko hai kinautolu ʻaki ha pōpoaki kuo fakamoʻoni pea ʻoku hū ai kinautolu ʻe he WeKan, ʻo ngaohi ʻa e ʻakauni ʻi he ʻuluaki hū ki loto.
help-admin-saml-how-it-works-description: Tohi ʻa e tuʻasila hū ki loto mo e tohi fakamoʻoni fakamoʻoni ʻo e tokotaha ʻoatu ʻilo, hingoa ʻo e tokotaha tuku ʻo e WeKan ni mo e ngaahi fili kehe ʻi he konga ni, pe ʻi he ngaahi fokotuʻutuʻu ʻo e sēvea; ʻoku ikuna ha mahuʻinga kuo tauhi ʻi heni ʻi he ʻa e sēvea. ʻO ka fakaʻaliʻali, ʻoku fakahaaʻi ʻe he peesi hū ki loto ha meʻa lomiʻi Hū ki loto ʻaki ʻa e SAML ʻoku ne ʻave ʻa e tokotaha ngāueʻaki ki he tokotaha ʻoatu ʻilo pea toe foki mai.
help-admin-ldap-what-it-is-description: ʻOku tuku ʻe he hū ki loto LDAP ke hū ʻa e kakai ʻaki ʻa e hingoa ngāueʻaki mo e lea fufū kuo nau ʻosi maʻu ʻi hoʻo tohi fakahinohino, hangē ko e Active Directory pe OpenLDAP. ʻOku sivi ʻe he WeKan ʻa e lea fufū ʻi he tohi fakahinohino, ngaohi ʻa e ʻakauni ʻi he ʻuluaki hū ki loto pea ʻe lava ke tauhi tatau ʻa e ngaahi hingoa, ʻīmeili, tuʻunga pule, kautaha mo e timi mo e tohi fakahinohino.
help-admin-ldap-how-it-works-description: Fakafonu ʻa e tuʻasila, matapā, fakapulipuli mo e tefito ʻo e tohi fakahinohino pea mo e founga kumi ʻo e kau ngāueʻaki, pea tauhi; ʻoku ikuna ha mahuʻinga kuo tauhi ʻi he ngaahi fokotuʻutuʻu ʻo e sēvea pea ʻoku toe ʻomi ʻe he Tuʻumaʻu ʻa e mahuʻinga ʻo e sēvea. Lomiʻi ʻa e Sivi Fehokotaki LDAP ke sivi ʻa e ngaahi fokotuʻutuʻu ʻoku ngāue, pea Fakatatau ʻa e kau ngāueʻaki LDAP ni ke lele leva ʻa e fakatatau ʻi mui. Fili ʻa e LDAP ko e founga tuʻumaʻu ʻi he konga Hū ki loto.
help-admin-oauth2-what-it-is-description: ʻOku tuku ʻe he hū ki loto OAuth2 mo OpenID Connect ke hū ʻa e kakai ʻaki ha ʻakauni ʻi ha sēvesi kehe, hangē ko e Keycloak, Authelia pe GitLab, kae ʻikai ko ha lea fufū WeKan. ʻOku ʻikai hangē ko e kau ʻoatu hū ki loto fakasōsiale pau, ʻoku ke tuhu ia ki ha tokotaha ʻoatu pē ʻaki hono ʻoatu hono ngaahi tuʻasila.
help-admin-oauth2-how-it-works-descripti: Lesisita ʻa e WeKan ko ha polokalama ʻi he tokotaha ʻoatu, pea tohi ʻi heni hono ʻilo kasitomaa, meʻa fufū, tuʻasila sēvea, ngaahi ngataʻanga mo e founga ʻoku fehoanaki ai hono ngaahi malaʻe tokotaha ngāueʻaki ki he WeKan; ʻoku ikuna ha mahuʻinga kuo tauhi ʻi heni ʻi he ngaahi fokotuʻutuʻu ʻo e sēvea pea ʻoku ngāue ʻi he hū ki loto hoko taʻe toe kamata. ʻOku fakahaaʻi leva ʻe he peesi hū ki loto ha meʻa lomiʻi hū ki loto ʻoku fokotuʻu hono tohi ʻi he konga Hū ki loto.
help-admin-cas-what-it-is-description: Ko e CAS ko ha founga hū ki loto tuʻo taha pē: ʻoku hū ʻa e kakai tuʻo taha ʻi he sēvea CAS ʻo hoʻo kautaha, pea ʻoku falala ʻa e WeKan ki he tikite ʻoku ne ʻoatu, ko ia ʻoku ʻikai ʻaupito sio ʻa e WeKan ki he lea fufū.
help-admin-cas-how-it-works-description: Tohi ʻi heni ʻa e tuʻasila tefito, hū ki loto mo e fakapapauʻi ʻo e sēvea CAS pea fakaʻaliʻali ia; ʻoku ikuna ha mahuʻinga kuo tauhi ʻi heni ʻi he ngaahi fokotuʻutuʻu ʻo e sēvea. Fili ʻa e CAS ko e founga tuʻumaʻu ʻi he konga Hū ki loto, pe tuku ke fili ia ʻe he kau ngāueʻaki mei he meʻa fili founga. ʻOku ʻave ʻe he hū ki loto ʻa e palausa ki he peesi hū ki loto CAS pea toe foki ki he WeKan, kuo hū ki loto.
help-admin-header-login-what-it-is-descr: ʻOku tuku ʻe he hū ki loto ʻulu ke tala ʻe ha sēvea fakafetongi falalaʻanga kuo ʻosi fai ʻa e hū ki loto tuʻo taha pē ki he WeKan pe ko hai ʻa e tokotaha ngāueʻaki, ko ia ʻoku hū ki loto ʻa e tokotaha ngāueʻaki taʻe ha lea fufū pea ʻoku ngaohi ʻa e ʻakauni ʻi he ʻuluaki ʻaʻahi.
help-admin-header-login-how-it-works-des: ʻOku fakahaaʻi ʻi heni ʻa e ngaahi fokotuʻutuʻu ni ke lau pē pea ʻoku ʻikai lava ke tauhi mei he Palanisi ʻo e pule, koeʻuhi ʻe lava ʻe ha sēvea fakafetongi falalaʻanga ʻo hū ki loto ko ha taha pē; ʻoku fokotuʻu kinautolu ʻi he ngaahi fokotuʻutuʻu ʻo e sēvea mo ha toe kamata. Kuo pau ke fakapapauʻi ʻe he sēvea fakafetongi ʻa e tokotaha ngāueʻaki, ʻave ʻa e ngaahi ʻulu ʻilo pea toʻo ha ngaahi ʻulu pehē kuo ʻave ʻe he kasitomaa, pea ko e ngaahi tuʻasila sēvea fakafetongi pē kuo lisi ʻoku falalaʻi.
help-admin-oauth-providers-what-it-is-de: Ko e ngaahi meʻa lomiʻi hū ki loto fakasōsiale kuo mateuteu ʻeni: Google, GitHub, Facebook, Twitter, Meteor Developer, Weibo mo e Meetup. ʻOku fie maʻu pē ʻe he taha kotoa ʻa e ʻilo polokalama mo e meʻa fufū ʻoku ʻoatu ʻe he tokotaha ʻoatu, pea ʻe lava ke ngāueʻaki kinautolu fakataha mo e hū ki loto OAuth2 fakalūkufua.
help-admin-oauth-providers-how-it-works-: Ngaohi ha polokalama ʻi he saiti fakatupulaki ʻo e tokotaha ʻoatu mo e tuʻasila foki ʻo e WeKan, pea tohi ʻi heni hono ʻilo mo e meʻa fufū pea fakaʻaliʻali ʻa e tokotaha ʻoatu; ʻoku ikuna ha mahuʻinga kuo tauhi ʻi heni ʻi he ngaahi fokotuʻutuʻu ʻo e sēvea. ʻOku hā leva ʻi he peesi hū ki loto ha meʻa lomiʻi Hū ki loto ʻaki ki he tokotaha ʻoatu ko ia.
help-admin-passwordless-what-it-is-descr: ʻOku tuku ʻe he hū ki loto taʻe lea fufū ke hū ʻa e tokotaha ngāueʻaki ʻaki ha koti tuʻo taha pē ʻoku ʻīmeili ange ʻe he WeKan, kae ʻikai ko ha lea fufū. Ko ha meʻa faingofua ia ki he kakai ʻoku ngalo ʻenau lea fufū, kae ʻikai ko ha fakapapauʻi hono ua, pea ʻoku malu pē ia ʻo hangē ko e puha meili ʻo e tokotaha ngāueʻaki.
help-admin-passwordless-how-it-works-des: Fakapapauʻi ʻoku ngāue ʻa e ʻīmeili ʻalu ki tuʻa, pea fakaʻaliʻali ia ʻi heni; ʻoku ikuna ha mahuʻinga kuo tauhi ʻi heni ʻi he ngaahi fokotuʻutuʻu ʻo e sēvea. ʻOku ʻoatu leva ʻe he peesi hū ki loto ke ʻīmeili ha koti hū ki loto: ʻoku tohi ʻe he tokotaha ngāueʻaki hono tuʻasila, maʻu ha koti ʻoku ngāue ʻi ha taimi nounou, tohi ia pea hū ki loto.
help-admin-backup-what-it-is-description: ʻOku toʻo ʻe he Tatau Malu ha tauhiʻanga ʻo e WeKan ni he taimi ni pe ʻo fakatatau ki ha taimi tēpile, mo e fakamatala tohi, meʻa fakapipiki mo e ngaahi tā ko ha ngaahi fili kehekehe, pea fakafoki ia. ʻOku fai ʻe ha pule ʻo e saiti ʻa e tatau malu ʻo e fokotuʻu kakato pe ha kautaha ʻe taha; ʻoku fai pē ʻe he pule ʻoʻona pē ʻo ha kautaha ʻa e tatau malu ʻo hono ngaahi papa. ʻOku ʻave hokohoko ʻe he Tatau Malu Hokohoko ʻa e liliu kotoa ko ia ʻe lava ke ke fakafoki ki ha taimi pē.
help-admin-backup-how-it-works-descripti: Fili ʻa e feituʻu, fakaʻilongaʻi ʻa e meʻa ke kau ai pea lomiʻi ʻa e Tatau malu he taimi ni; ʻoku fie maʻu ʻe ha tatau malu kakato ʻa e meʻa ʻe tolu kotoa mo e fokotuʻu kakato. Fokotuʻu ha taimi tēpile fakaʻaho, fakauike pe fakamāhina pea Tauhi. Lomiʻi ʻa e Lisi ʻo e ngaahi tatau malu pea fakafoki ha taha, ʻo tānaki pē ʻa e fakamatala ʻoku mole pe fetongi ʻa e meʻa kotoa. ʻI he Tatau Malu Hokohoko, fokotuʻu ʻa e foʻi tohi taumuʻa, meʻa ʻi loto mo e tauhi, pea fili ha poini fakafoki.
help-admin-attachments-what-it-is-descri: ʻOku fili ʻe he ngaahi konga Ngaahi meʻa fakapipiki ʻa e feituʻu ʻoku tauhi ai ʻa e ngaahi meʻa fakapipiki ʻo e kaati mo e ngaahi tā, ko honau lahi taha, ko e lōloa ʻo e tauhi kinautolu mo e founga ʻoku nau hiki ai ʻi he vahaʻa ʻo e ngaahi tauhiʻanga. ʻE lava ke tauhi ʻa e ngaahi faile ʻi he tisi ʻo e sēvea, ʻi he tauhiʻanga fakamatala pe ʻi ha tauhiʻanga ʻao hangē ko e S3, MinIO, Azure, Google Cloud Storage pe WebDAV.
help-admin-attachments-how-it-works-desc: Fili ha konga mei he lisi fili toʻohema. Fokotuʻu ʻa e tauhiʻanga ʻoku ʻalu ki ai ʻa e ngaahi faile foʻou, fokotuʻu ʻa e tauhiʻanga taki taha mo hono ngaahi meʻa liliu lau mo e tohi ʻoʻona pē, pea hiki ʻa e ngaahi meʻa fakapipiki pe tā mei ha tauhiʻanga ʻe taha ki ha taha kehe. ʻOku fokotuʻu ʻe he Ngaahi Fakangatangata ʻa e lahi ʻo e hiki hake mo e hiki hifo, ʻoku tāmateʻi ʻe he Tauhi ʻa e ngaahi meʻa fakapipiki motuʻa hili ha ngaahi ʻaho, pea ʻoku hiki ʻe he Hiki Tauhiʻanga fakamatala ʻa e fakamatala tohi ʻi he vahaʻa ʻo e MongoDB mo e FerretDB.
help-admin-problems-summary-what-it-is-d: Ko e ʻuluaki peesi ʻo e Palanisi ʻo e pule ʻi he Ngaahi Palopalema pea ko hoʻo sivi fakaʻaho ʻo e sēvea kakato. ʻOku ne tala atu ʻa e meʻa ʻoku lele he taimi ni, ʻa e meʻa ʻoku hala he taimi ni, pea ko e palopalema foʻou ʻe fiha kuo tānaki ʻe he lipooti taki taha, mo e ngaahi meʻa lomiʻi ke fakatonutonu pe tali kinautolu.
help-admin-problems-summary-how-it-works: ʻOku lisi ʻe he Tuʻunga ʻa e ngaahi hiki mo e fakaleleiʻi ʻoku lolotonga fai, ʻa ia ʻe lava ke fakatuai ʻa e hū ki loto, hoko ai ʻa e palopalema taki taha mo hano lau mo e meʻa ke fai, pea mo ha meʻa lomiʻi Fakaleleiʻi ʻa e ngaahi kaati maumau, Fakafoki pe Fakaleleiʻi ʻo kapau ʻoku feʻunga. ʻOku kole ʻe ha fakaleleiʻi ʻoku ne tāmateʻi ha fakamatala ke ke ʻuluaki lomiʻi ʻa e Fakapapauʻi. ʻI lalo ʻi he Moʻui lelei ʻo e fakamatala, ʻoku lele ʻe he Kamata ha sivi ʻi mui. ʻI lalo ʻi he Ngaahi Palopalema, fakaʻilongaʻi ʻa e ngaahi lipooti kuo ke vakai ki ai pea lomiʻi ʻa e Tali ke toe kamata honau lau foʻou, pe Fakamaʻa ke tāmateʻi honau ngaahi laine.
help-admin-problems-security-what-it-is-: Ko e feinga kotoa naʻe taʻe tali pe ʻiloʻi ʻe ha leʻo malu: ko e hā ia, ʻoku fēfē hono mamafa, ko hai naʻa ne feinga, mei fē pea tuʻo fiha. ʻOku ne fakahaaʻi naʻe feinga ha taha, kae ʻikai ko e tāpuni pē ʻa e ava. ʻOku ʻi he Palanisi ʻo e pule ʻi he Ngaahi fokotuʻutuʻu ʻi he Malu ʻa e ngaahi meʻa liliu malu tonu.
help-admin-problems-security-how-it-work: ʻOku lisi ʻa e ngaahi laine ʻo muʻomuʻa ʻa e foʻou taha, pea ko ha feinga toe hoko ko ha laine pē ʻe taha ʻoku tupu hono lau Feinga, kae tala ʻe he Fakaikiiki ʻa e meʻa naʻe sio ki ai ʻa e leʻo. Tohi ha hingoa, faʻahinga, matavai, hingoa ngāueʻaki pe tuʻasila ʻi he puha kumi ke fakamaʻa lolotonga hoʻo tohi, pea lomiʻi ha hingoa ngāueʻaki ke fakaava ʻa e ʻakauni ko ia. Tali pe fakamaʻa ʻa e lipooti ʻi he Ngaahi Palopalema ʻi he Fakanounou.
help-admin-problems-impersonation-what-i: Ko e lekooti sivi ʻo e kau pule ʻoku nau ngāue ʻi he hingoa ʻo ha kau ngāueʻaki kehe. ʻOku tuku ʻe he ngāue ʻi he hingoa ʻo ke sio ʻa e pule ki he WeKan ʻo hangē ko e sio ʻa ha tokotaha ngāueʻaki ʻe taha, hangē ko hono ʻave ha papa fakafoʻituitui, pea ʻoku tauhi ʻe he lipooti ni ke hā mahino ʻa e mālohi ko ia ki mui.
help-admin-problems-impersonation-how-it: ʻOku tohi ha laine ʻo ka fili ʻe ha pule ʻa e Ngāue ʻi he hingoa ʻo e tokotaha ngāueʻaki ʻi he Palanisi ʻo e pule ʻi he Kakai, ngaohi ha tokeni hū ki loto ki ha tokotaha ngāueʻaki kehe ʻi he REST API, pe ʻave ha papa, kaati pe meʻa fakapipiki lolotonga ʻene ngāue ʻi he hingoa ʻo ha taha. ʻOku fakahaaʻi ʻe he laine taki taha ʻa e ʻaho, ko e pule, ko e tokotaha ngāueʻaki, ko e papa mo e ʻuhinga, ʻoku muʻomuʻa ʻa e foʻou taha. Lomiʻi ha hingoa ke fakaava ʻa e tokotaha ngāueʻaki ko ia, pea kumi ʻaki ʻa e Enter. ʻOku ʻikai liliu pe tāmateʻi ʻe ha meʻa ʻi heni ha laine.
help-admin-problems-password-length-what: ʻOku fakahaaʻi ʻa hai ʻoku hū ki loto ʻaki ha lea fufū ʻoku nounou ange ʻi he lōloa siʻisiʻi taha, mei fē, pea pe kuo nau liliu ia talu mei ai. ʻE lava ke ke sio pe ko hai ʻe uesia kimuʻa pea ke fakamālohiʻi ha siʻisiʻi taha ki he ngaahi lea fufū foʻou.
help-admin-problems-password-length-how-: Fokotuʻu ʻa e Lōloa siʻisiʻi taha ʻo e lea fufū, fakaʻilongaʻi ʻa e Fakamālohiʻi ʻa e lōloa siʻisiʻi taha ke taʻe tali ʻa e ngaahi lea fufū foʻou nounou ange, pea lomiʻi ʻa e Tauhi. ʻOku ʻikai ʻaupito taʻe tali ʻa e hū ki loto, ka ʻo ka fakamālohiʻi, ʻoku kole ki ha ʻakauni mo ha lea fufū nounou motuʻa ke ʻuluaki liliu ia. ʻOku ʻi he tēpile ha laine ʻe taha ki he ʻakauni taki taha mo e ʻuluaki mo e hū ki loto fakamuimui, ngaahi tuʻasila, lau ʻo e hū ki loto mo e taimi naʻe fakatonutonu ai. help-admin-problems-api-what-it-is-descr: ʻOku fakahaaʻi pe ko e fē ngaahi ngataʻanga REST API ʻoku ngāueʻaki, ʻe hai pea tuʻo fiha. ʻOku tala ʻe he ngaahi konga kehe ʻa e meʻa naʻe hala; ʻoku tala ʻe he konga ni ʻa e meʻa ʻoku kole ki he sēvea ke fai. ʻI ha sēvea ʻoku ʻikai fakaʻaliʻali ai ʻa e REST API, ʻoku nofo maha ia.
help-admin-problems-api-how-it-works-des: Ko e laine taki taha ko ha ʻakauni mo ha ngataʻanga, ʻoku muʻomuʻa ʻa e femoʻuekina taha: ko e lau ui, taimi naʻe ʻuluaki mo fakamuimui ui ai, pea mo e ngaahi tuʻasila IPv4 mo IPv6 fakamuimui mo honau feituʻu. Ko ha hingoa ngāueʻaki maha ʻoku ʻuhinga ko e ngaahi ui mei ha taha taʻe ha ʻakauni, ʻoku ʻiloʻi ʻaki ʻa e ngaahi tuʻasila. Tohi ha ngataʻanga, founga, hingoa ngāueʻaki pe tuʻasila ke fakamaʻa lolotonga hoʻo tohi, pea fakaholo ʻi he laine ʻe 10 ʻi he taimi taki taha.
help-admin-problems-database-what-it-is-: ʻOku fakamatalaʻi ʻa e meʻa naʻe pehē ʻe he tauhiʻanga fakamatala. ʻOku angamaheni ʻo tohi ha fehalaaki mei he MongoDB, SQLite, PostgreSQL, MySQL, MariaDB pe SAP HANA ki hono kau fakatupulaki, ko ia ʻoku fakahingoa ʻe he konga ni ʻa e tauhiʻanga fakamatala, fakakulupu ʻa e palopalema ki ha faʻahinga hangē ko e tisi, hū ki loto, fōtunga lea pe ngata taimi, pea tānaki ha fakamatala mahino mo e sitepu hoko.
help-admin-problems-database-how-it-work: ʻOku lisi ʻa e ngaahi laine ʻo muʻomuʻa ʻa e foʻou taha. ʻOku tala ʻe he Fakaikiiki ʻa e ʻuhinga ʻo e palopalema mo e meʻa ke fai, hoko ai ʻa e pōpoaki ʻoʻona pē ʻo e tauhiʻanga fakamatala, pea ʻoku fakahaaʻi ʻe he ngaahi kolomu kehe ʻa e tauhiʻanga fakamatala, faʻahinga, mamafa, ngāue, ko hai mo mei fē ʻo kapau ʻoku ʻilo, pea tuʻo fiha. ʻOku fakamaʻa ʻe he Kumi lolotonga hoʻo tohi, kau ai ʻa e ngaahi lea ʻoʻona pē ʻo e tauhiʻanga fakamatala. ʻO ka ʻosi hono fakaleleiʻi, tali pe fakamaʻa ia ʻi he Ngaahi Palopalema ʻi he Fakanounou.
help-admin-problems-integrity-what-it-is: ʻOku fakahaaʻi pe naʻe taʻofi lelei ʻa e sēvea ni, ko e hā naʻe holoki ia, pea pe naʻe hala ʻa e tatau malu hokohoko, fakataha mo e ngaahi meʻa lomiʻi sivi faile tatau mo e Lipooti Faile. Vakai ki heni hili ha mate taʻe ʻamanekina.
help-admin-problems-integrity-how-it-wor: ʻOku tohi ha laine ki ha toe kamata taʻe ha taʻofi lelei, ko ha toe kamata vave ʻo kapau naʻe foki mai ʻa e sēvea ʻi loto ʻi he miniti ʻe tolu pe ko ha holo ʻo kapau naʻe mate fuoloa ange, ki ha fehalaaki taʻe puke mo hono pōpoaki, pea ʻo ka hala ʻa e tatau malu hokohoko. ʻOku muʻomuʻa ʻa e ngaahi laine foʻou taha, ʻe 10 ʻi he peesi, pea ʻoku fakamaʻa ʻe he kumi lolotonga hoʻo tohi. ʻOku ʻikai liliu ʻe he ngaahi meʻa lomiʻi sivi faile ʻi ʻolunga ha faile pe lekooti. Tali pe fakamaʻa ia ʻi he Ngaahi Palopalema ʻi he Fakanounou.
help-admin-cloud-what-it-is-description: Ko e Palanisi ʻAo ko e peesi ia ʻa ha tokotaha puleʻi tauhi ke puleʻi ha ngaahi tuʻasila WeKan lahi ʻo e kasitomaa mei ha feituʻu pē ʻe taha: honau ngaahi ʻaho, tauhiʻanga fakamatala, ʻinivoisi, tikite tokoni mo e talanoa, lekooti DNS mo e ngaahi hala sēvea uepi. ʻOku ʻi ai pē ia ʻo ka fakaʻaliʻali ia ʻe he ngaahi fokotuʻutuʻu ʻo e sēvea ki hono tuʻasila ʻoʻona pē, pea ko e kau pule pē ʻo e saiti ʻi ai, ko e Kau Pule ʻAo, ʻoku nau sio ki ai.
help-admin-cloud-how-it-works-descriptio: Tānaki ha ngaahi tuʻasila kasitomaa mo honau ngaahi ʻaho mo pe ʻoku ʻi ai ʻa e taha kotoa hano WeKan mo e tauhiʻanga fakamatala ʻoʻona pē pe ʻoku vahevahe ʻa e taha ni, sivi ʻa e fehokotaki ki he tauhiʻanga fakamatala, pea tohi ʻa e ngaahi ʻinivoisi. ʻOku maʻu ʻe he tuʻasila taki taha ha papa tokoni ki he ngaahi tikite mo e talanoa. Sivi mo fakafoʻou ʻa e ngaahi lekooti DNS, ʻomi ʻa e ngaahi hala sēvea uepi, pea lisi ʻa e ngaahi tuʻasila ʻoku ngofua ke fakangatangata ʻa e feituʻu ʻe lava ke hū mei ai ʻa e Kau Pule ʻAo. ʻOku hū ʻa e kau kasitomaa ke sio ki honau tuʻasila pē ʻoʻonautolu.
help-all-boards-what-it-is-description: Ko e Ngaahi papa kotoa ko e peesi ia ʻoku ne lisi hoʻo ngaahi papa. ʻOku fili ʻe he lisi fili toʻohema ʻa e ngaahi papa ʻoku fakahaaʻi, hangē ko e Kuo Fakaʻilongaʻi, Toenga, ʻApi, Ngaahi sīpinga, Tauhiʻanga, ha feituʻu ngāue pe ha kautaha pe timi, pea ʻoku ʻi he paʻa ʻulu ʻa e fakahokohoko, kumi, ʻave mo e Fili lahi.
help-all-boards-how-it-works-description: Lomiʻi ha konga ʻi he lisi fili toʻohema pea ha papa ke fakaava ia. Ngāueʻaki ʻa e Fakahokohoko Ngaahi papa ki ha hokohoko toho fakatāutaha pe ʻaki ʻa e kaveinga, pea ko e lisi fili vīsone ke liliu ʻi he vahaʻa ʻo e ngaahi fakaʻilonga papa mo ha tēpile. Fakaʻaliʻali ʻa e Fili lahi pea fakaʻilongaʻi ʻa e ngaahi papa ke tuku ki he Tauhiʻanga, hiki tatau, ʻave pe fokotuʻu ha taha ko ho papa ʻApi, pe toho ha papa ki he Tauhiʻanga.
help-workload-what-it-is-description: ʻOku fakahaaʻi ʻe he Kavenga ngāue mo e malava, ʻi he uike taki taha, ʻa e lahi ʻo e ngāue ʻoku maʻu ʻe he tokotaha taki taha ʻo fakahoa ki he ngaahi houa ʻoku nau maʻu, ʻi he papa kotoa ʻoku ke ngāue ai. ʻOku ne fakahaaʻi pe ko hai ʻoku mamafa fau, ko hai ʻe lava ʻo toʻo lahi ange, pea ko e hā ʻoku fie maʻu ʻe ha poloseki ʻoku haʻu kimuʻa pea fakahingoa ha taha.
help-workload-how-it-works-description: Fili ʻa e ʻuluaki uike, ko e uike ʻe fiha pea pe ke fakahaaʻi ʻa e ngaahi houa pe ngaahi poini talanoa, pea lomiʻi ha uike ke sio ki hono ngaahi kaati. ʻOku kulokula ʻa e ngaahi uike ʻoku lahi ange ai ʻa e ngāue ʻi he ngaahi houa. Fokotuʻu hoʻo taimi ngāue pē ʻaʻau, ngaahi taukei mo e ngaahi taimi ʻikai ʻi ai, ʻoku tānaki ʻe he kau pule ʻo e papa ʻa e ngaahi vahe mo e ngaahi feituʻu tatali ki he ngaahi fatongia, pea ʻoku tānaki ʻe he kau pule ʻa e ngaahi ʻaho mālōlō fakapuleʻanga.
help-billing-what-it-is-description: Ko e Patiseti mo e totongi ko e feituʻu ia ʻoku palani mo totongiʻi ai ʻe he kau pule ʻo e papa ʻa e ngāue ʻa ha papa: hono patiseti, ko e hā kuo totongi mo e hā ʻe totongi ʻa e ngāue, ngaahi totongi fakahoua, ngaahi fakamole, totongi pau, ngaahi fakamatala totongi mo e ngaahi ʻinivoisi, ʻo makatuʻunga ʻi he taimi kuo tohi ʻi he ngaahi kaati.
help-billing-how-it-works-description: Fili ha paʻanga mo e ngaahi totongi fakahoua ki he mēmipa taki taha mo ha tuʻumaʻu ki he papa, fokotuʻu ha patiseti, pea tānaki ʻa e ngaahi fakamole mo e totongi. ʻOku hā leva ʻa e taimi kuo tohi ʻi he ngaahi kaati ko e kuo ngāueʻaki mo e tomuʻa fakafuofua ʻo fakahoa ki he patiseti. ʻO kapau ʻoku ke loto, tali ʻa e taimi kimuʻa pea ʻinivoisi. Fakafonu tuʻo taha pē ho ngaahi fakaikiiki tokotaha ʻinivoisi, pea ngaohi ʻa e ngaahi ʻinivoisi ki ha vahaʻa taimi, hiki hifo kinautolu, fakaʻilongaʻi kuo ʻave pea tohi ʻa e ngaahi totongi, pe ngaohi ha fakamatala totongi ki he ngāue ʻoku kei toe ke fai.

gitea-not-configured: ʻOku ʻikai fokotuʻu ha fōlitā Gitea. Fokotuʻu ʻa e GITEA_APP_INI ʻi he peesi Ngaahi fokotuʻutuʻu.

gitea-not-sqlite: ʻOku lau pē ʻe Omi ha Gitea ʻoku ne ngāueʻaki ʻa e SQLite. ʻOku ngāueʻaki ʻe he Gitea ko ʻeni:
gitea-owners: Kau ngāueʻaki mo e ngaahi kautaha
gitea-read-only: ʻOku lau pē ʻe he ngaahi peesi ko ʻeni ʻa e fōlitā Gitea; ʻoku ʻikai ha meʻa heni ʻe liliu ia.
gitea-tree: Lisi tree -s ʻo e fōlitā Gitea, ʻikai fakamaʻu
gitea-delete: Tāmateʻi ʻa e tokotaha ngāueʻaki pe kautaha ko ʻeni
gitea-dry-run: Kei teʻeki ai ha meʻa kuo liliu; ko e meʻa ʻeni ʻe fai ʻe he tāmateʻí.
gitea-delete-plan: Ko hono tāmateʻí ʻoku toʻo ai ʻa e ngaahi laine mo e ngaahi faile ko ʻeni:
gitea-delete-confirm: ʻOku tāmateʻi taʻengata ʻe he meʻá ni ʻa e tokotaha ngāueʻaki pe kautaha, hono ngaahi tauhiʻanga mo ʻenau fakamatala kotoa mei he fōlitā Gitea. Tohiʻi ʻa e hingoá ke hoko atu:
gitea-delete-wrong-name: Ko e hingoa naʻe tohiʻí ʻoku ʻikai ko e hingoa ia ʻo e tokotaha ʻoku ʻaʻaná. Naʻe ʻikai tāmateʻi ha meʻa.
gitea-running: ʻOku lele ʻa Gitea. Taʻofi ia ʻuluaki: ʻOku tohi pē ʻa Omi ki ha Gitea kuo taʻofi.
gitea-blocked: ʻOku ʻikai lava ke tāmateʻi ʻa e meʻá ni:
gitea-backup-first: Fai ʻuluaki ha tatau malu: ko e tatau malu github-to-gitea ʻo e tokotaha ʻoku ʻaʻana ko ʻeni, mei GitHub ki BACKUPS_DIR. ʻE hoko atu pē ʻa e tāmateʻí ʻo kapau ʻe lavameʻa ʻa e tatau malú.
gitea-backup-existing: Tatau malu github-to-gitea ʻoku ʻi ai
gitea-no-backup: ʻOku ʻikai ha tatau malu github-to-gitea ʻo e tokotaha ʻoku ʻaʻana ko ʻeni ʻi BACKUPS_DIR.
gitea-job-started: Kuo kamata. Ko e lēkooti ʻeni ʻo e ngāué:
gitea-job-done: Kuo ʻosi mo e kouti mavahe
gitea-import-help: ʻOku ne hū mai ha kautaha pe tokotaha ngāueʻaki ʻo GitHub, pe ko ha niʻihi ʻo hono ngaahi tauhiʻanga, hangatonu ki he fōlitā Gitea: git, ngaahi palopalema, ngaahi kole fusi, ngaahi fakamatala, ngaahi leipolo, ngaahi maka fakamaile, ngaahi tukuange mo e ngaahi meʻa fakapipiki. Kuo pau ke taʻofi ʻa Gitea. Toe lele ia ke ʻomai pē ʻa e meʻa foʻou pe kuo liliu.

gitea-bad-name: ʻOku ʻikai ko ha hingoa totonu ia ʻo ha tokotaha ʻoku ʻaʻana pe tauhiʻanga.
gitea-doer: Tokotaha ngāueʻaki Gitea ʻoku fai ʻaki ʻa e hū maí

gitea-sync-exclude-file: lisi ʻo e ngaahi tauhiʻanga ʻoku ʻikai toe fetuʻutaki ʻe github-to-gitea mo Omi
gitea-delete-repo: Tāmateʻi ʻa e tauhiʻanga ko ʻení mo hono ngaahi faile

gitea-exclude-too: Toʻo foki ia mei he fetuʻutakí, koeʻuhi ke ʻoua ʻe toe ʻomi ia ʻe he fetuʻutaki hokó
gitea-packages-unlinked: Ko e ngaahi kato naʻe fehokotaki mo ia ʻoku nofo pē mo e tokotaha ʻoku ʻaʻaná, ʻikai fehokotaki:
gitea-index-stale: Kuo motuʻa talu mei ha tāmateʻi: toe fua ki he ngaahi lahi totonu.
